jobs.title: Project Coordinator I
jobs.description:
**About Company:**

**Element U.S. Space & Defense** stands at the forefront of testing innovation, serving as a trusted partner to NASA, the U.S. Department of Defense, government agencies, and prominent industry leaders across the space and defense sectors. Founded as NTS Technical Systems, our company brings over 60 years of experience and expertise in handling the most complex projects and programs in the world.

From centrifuge testing for the latest Mars rover, vibration testing for the Space Launch System (SLS), to environmental simulations for next-generation missiles, we are the pioneering partner for highly custom, end-to-end testing design and implementation. By advancing our state-of-the-art testing technologies, subject matter expertise, and service to critical missions, Element U.S. Space & Defense has become the go-to partner for ground-breaking industries.

**What We Offer:**

**Growth & Development:**

* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment.
* The chance to work on groundbreaking projects that shape the future of space and defense.

**Benefits:**  
Employees are eligible to participate in the benefits offered throughout their availability, including the following:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Short- and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts
* Seven (7) paid holidays and four (4) paid floating holidays, depending on your hire date
* Paid Time Off (PTO), accrued biweekly
* 401k with employer match
* Twelve (12) hours of Paid Volunteer Time Off (PVTO) each year
* Tuition reimbursement and other employee programs
* Flexible schedules offered at some of our labs
* Monthly Lab Bonus plans (Based on position)

**Salary:**  
At EUSSD, compensation is determined through a comprehensive approach that considers candidate qualifications, role responsibilities, market benchmarks, and organizational needs. Pay may vary by location; for this position, the annual base salary target range is $21.00 - $23.00/hr, with potential eligibility for bonuses or commission depending on the role.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Manages a book of active customer orders that consists primarily of quick-turn, transactional work. Primarily focused on ensuring production testing is completed on time (speed of completion is a priority). Manages the flow of work within or between departments. Provides the level of customer engagement required by type of project and specific customer to ensure the customer's needs and expectations are met. Acts as a customer service representative and focuses on creating a positive customer experience.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

* Takes complete ownership of projects within book of business. Ownership entails:
* Fulfilling our commitments and customer needs,
* Delivering projects to operations in a timely manner to ensure schedule commitments can be met (CRDs and PDDs),
* Understanding project success means ensuring the project is completed on-time
* Providing customers with the expected amount of communication,
* Coordinating the flow of work through the facility with Customers and Department Managers,
* Consistently using the best practices of project coordination,
* Establishing collaborative and mutually supportive relationship with those responsible for operations,
* Striving to make operations successful.

**CORE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Performs duties for standard work with the use of standard SOPs.
* Ensures production tests are completed on-time.
* Works with operations to expedite testing through the facility.
* Follows standard practices and procedures in managing order book.
* Builds productive internal and external working relationships.
* May be responsible for billing of projects.
* Proactively manages planned subcontracted work (i.e: IJOs and non-EUSSD subcontractors) including setting expectations with the subcontractor and monitoring subcontractor progress.
* With assistance, able to manage unplanned subcontracted work.
* Primarily repeat work (operations as opposed to projects).
* Is primary point of contact for customer questions.
* Usually minimal customer interaction required due to quick timing of testing.
* Communication typically limited to confirmation of receipt/testing (CRD) initiation and test completion (PDD).
* Communicates schedule changes to the customer.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 1 - 3 years' experience. Customer service experience required.
* Must be organized and practice time management.
* Must have strong communication skills to work with different internal partners and customers.
* Applies company policies and procedures to resolve routine issues.
* Basic MS office skills.
* Basic skills in prescribed internal tools (scheduling, ERP, etc.).

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

Test lab with exposure to sudden, loud noises

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; climb stairs; balance; stoop; kneel; crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

**EEO POLICY STATEMENT:**

It is the policy of EUSSD to offer Equal Employment Opportunity to all individuals without regards to race, creed, ancestry, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, age, national origin, physical disabilities, pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions.

Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V

jobs.title: Production Coordinator, A+E Studios
jobs.description:
A+E Global Media offers a work environment where employees collaborate in office 3 times per week. New hires must be commutable to one of our current office locations in New York City, Los Angeles, Chicago, and Stamford, CT. Please refer to the job description for any specific division requirements.

**Division Story**
==================

A+E Global Media is not in the television business. It’s in the storytelling business. Our job is to bring consumers new ways to experience those stories. We get up every day excited to discover new talent, narratives and characters, and live for any chance to shepherd a great idea through development to air.

**Job Description**
===================

**THE ROLE:**
=============

The **Production Coordinator** supports the Head of Production by managing complex scheduling, production documentation, reporting, travel logistics, payment processing, and cross-department coordination across multiple scripted television projects.

This role serves as a central operational hub for Studio Production as a bridge with Creative, Finance, Business Affairs, Legal, and external partners. The Production Coordinator ensures accurate documentation, timely communication, and smooth execution of workflows throughout development, prep, production, and post.

**MORE ABOUT WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
==============================

**Executive & Studio Support:**
-------------------------------

  

* Provide daily operational and administrative support to the Head of Production and as needed, the scripted production team.
* Prepare and send a daily agenda outlining meetings, priorities, deadlines, and production updates.
* Manage high-volume calendars and coordinate executive-level meetings across multiple departments and time zones.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for internal Studio teams and external partners.

**Scheduling & Meeting Coordination:**
--------------------------------------

  

* Maintain the daily schedule for the HOP. Schedule various department meetings for Head of Production and larger group meetings for the scripted production team with production service companies, producers, vendors, agencies, and production facilities.
* Lead the coordination of series production and concept meetings in collaboration with production office teams.
* Create internal Studio calendar invites for all external series production meetings as needed.
* Support pre-commencement kick-off meetings and post-mortem sessions through agenda preparation and coordination of all key participants.
* Capture detailed notes and action items during meetings, maintaining accurate records in Airtable and Box.

**Studio P-Report Management:**
-------------------------------

  

* Coordinate weekly reminders with Production and Production Finance teams to ensure meeting updates are collected and accurately reflected in the Excel tracker.
* Share materials in advance of meeting, screen share as needed, and note changes, comments and corrections during the weekly Studio meeting.

**Payment Processing:**

  

* Prepare and coordinate execution of commission agreements.
* Gather individual/Loanout company information and ensure alignment with internal payment processing requirements.
* Ensure agreement details match Production Finance payment records to avoid delays.
* Track and update payment statuses regularly in Airtable.

**Travel Coordination for the Head of Production:**
---------------------------------------------------

  

* Book executive travel through Disney Global Travel, including hotel, flights and ground transportation.
* Create travel itineraries and team travel grids as needed.
* Monitor travel expenses, manage itinerary changes, create travel agendas, and resolve travel related issues as they arise.

**Expense Management:**

  

* Manage expense reporting for the Head of Production including receipt collection, approval tracking, and resolution of returned submissions.
* Ensure compliance with A+E’s travel and expense policy.

**Asset & Document Management:**
--------------------------------

  

* Coordinate retrieval, delivery, and storage of production assets.
* Oversee digital document organization for scripted projects across Box and Scenechronize.
* Maintain and update project document trackers and studio comparison grids.

**General Meetings & Vetting Support:**
---------------------------------------

  

* Support the coordination of vetting meetings for production service partners and key production roles, tracking meetings and follow-ups in Airtable.
* Support cross-team communication with Production, Finance, Legal, and Creative leadership.

**On-Call & Studio Operations:**
--------------------------------

  

* Remain flexible and responsive in a fast-paced production environment.
* Support urgent production issues and last-minute scheduling needs.
* Serve as a point of contact for external teams seeking project status updates.
* Track long-term Studio deadlines, offsites, and departmental initiatives.

**BASIC REQUIREMENTS:**
=======================

  

* 2+ years of relevant industry experience
* Are local to the L.A. area and will work from Century City office 3 to 4 days a week.
* Have a positive and upbeat demeanor with strong time management and multitasking skills
* Strong communication, written, and organizational skills are essential
* Candidate must be able to work well in a fast-paced environment, work independently and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines
* Must work well in a team environment and maintain strong internal and external relationships.
* Passion for TV and cutting-edge technology and content
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Airtable and Scenechronize and familiar with on set paperwork.
* Must be able to handle maintain confidentiality

**Compensation**

jobs.title: Jewelry Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Production Coordinator is responsible for helping manage the daily flow of production from order entry through completion, quality review, and preparation for invoicing and shipment.

This position works closely with Production, Sales, Client Services, Accounting, Shipping, management, and outside vendors to ensure orders are progressing according to schedule, completed accurately, and meet MICHAEL M's quality standards.

The Production Coordinator is expected to maintain clear visibility into active orders, proactively identify delays or discrepancies, and follow through until issues are resolved.

Position Responsibilities

**Production Coordination and Order Management**

* Coordinate daily production orders and ensure orders are progressing according to schedule.
* Track production orders from start to finish and monitor expected completion and delivery dates.
* Coordinate with the production team to obtain accurate and timely updates on active orders.
* Identify orders that are delayed or at risk of missing their required delivery date and escalate concerns promptly.
* Prioritize and closely monitor rush orders, special orders, and other time-sensitive requests.
* Communicate with vendors and outside suppliers regarding materials, components, backorders, outstanding items, and rush requirements.
* Follow up consistently on outstanding production issues until they are resolved.
* Coordinate with Production, Sales, Client Services, Accounting, and Shipping to help ensure orders move efficiently through each stage of the process.

**Quality Control and Order Accuracy**

* Inspect finished merchandise for quality, workmanship, condition, and accuracy before products move to invoicing or shipment.
* Review completed merchandise against production orders, invoices, customer requirements, and applicable specifications.
* Verify item numbers, quantities, sizes, metals, materials, pricing, and other relevant order information.
* Confirm that finished merchandise matches the original order requirements and production instructions.
* Identify quality concerns, order discrepancies, missing information, or other issues before merchandise is invoiced or shipped.
* Communicate discrepancies to the appropriate department and coordinate corrections as needed.
* Assist in maintaining consistent MICHAEL M quality and accuracy standards throughout the production and fulfillment process.

**Order Processing and Documentation**

* Assist with order processing, quotes, production documentation, and other order-related requirements.
* Maintain accurate production statuses, notes, expected completion dates, and supporting information within company systems.
* Maintain organized and accurate production, quality control, and order records.
* Ensure relevant production updates and changes are communicated to the appropriate departments.
* Verify that required information and documentation are complete before orders move to the next stage.

**Production Reporting and Issue Resolution**

* Prepare weekly production reports for management.
* Maintain visibility into open orders, overdue orders, upcoming due dates, rush orders, backorders, and orders at risk of delay.
* Identify recurring production delays, bottlenecks, quality issues, or process problems and communicate them to management.
* Work with management and the appropriate departments to resolve production problems and minimize their impact on customer delivery dates.
* Assist with additional production and operational responsibilities as needed.

Core Expectations

Accuracy, attention to detail, reliability, urgency, organization, and consistent follow-through are essential requirements of this position.

The Production Coordinator is expected to take ownership of assigned orders and follow issues through resolution rather than simply reporting their status. Potential production or quality problems should be identified and communicated as early as possible so corrective action can be taken before they affect the customer.

Qualifications

* 2+ years of experience in production coordination, order management, manufacturing, quality control, operations, purchasing, or a related role preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple orders and deadlines simultaneously.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong follow-up and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to inspect products carefully and identify discrepancies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with internal departments, vendors, and suppliers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook.
* Experience with ERP, inventory, manufacturing, or order-management systems preferred.
* Jewelry, luxury goods, manufacturing, or related industry experience is a plus, but not required.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in production coordination, order processing, manufacturing, quality control, inventory, or a similar operational role?
* What hourly compensation range are you targeting for your next position?
* Are you comfortable working full-time, Monday through Friday, in our Burbank office?

Ability to Commute:

* Burbank, CA 91502 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

*This is a* ***6-month contract position*** *with the potential for extension or conversion to a full-time role based on performance and business needs. This role offers a strong opportunity to gain exposure to a fast-paced, high-growth recruiting environment and make a meaningful impact from day one.*

As a Recruiting Coordinator at CHAOS, you'll be a key player in driving our growth and expansion. Your role is vital in shaping the future success of our company, from managing daily recruitment activities to fostering positive candidate relationships throughout the entire process. You will be instrumental in creating a lasting impression on prospective candidates, setting the tone for their journey with us!

In this role, you'll report into our Recruiting Operations Manager and regularly partner with Recruiters and hiring teams to support the rapid development of our dynamic team. Your responsibilities encompass overseeing all aspects of the employee lifecycle, from interview scheduling, related logistics, and onboarding activities. Beyond that, you'll actively contribute to identifying opportunities for enhanced efficiency & improvements while exercising creativity and innovation toward making our experiences top-notch. Your primary objective will be to ensure an outstanding candidate & employee experience, making you an indispensable partner in guiding candidates seamlessly through our recruitment process and into their exciting career journey at CHAOS.

**Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate major aspects of the employee lifecycle from interview scheduling requests for candidates to executing onboarding tasks to assisting with new hire orientations
* Serve as a main point of contact with interview candidates, ensuring timely communication with them via phone, text, and email, ensuring a positive and informative experience
* Use (and identify where gaps exist) software tools to manage candidate logistics throughout the recruiting process such as booking travel & lodging accommodations, troubleshooting through last-minute scheduling changes, and facilitating onsite interview operations
* Liaise with hiring teams to ensure timely interview attendance, collect feedback and relay next steps for candidates while keeping hiring managers up to date on candidate statuses & recruiting process
* Manage logistics of the onsite interview process for candidates including: scheduling, facilitating tours, setting up conference rooms, ensuring interviewer attendance, and troubleshooting last-minute schedule changes
* Identify opportunities for process and system improvements, addressing bottlenecks and enhancing scheduling efficiency
* Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, including hiring teams, Operations and IT team members
* Participate in projects to support the recruiting function
* Work full-time onsite out of our office in Los Angeles (Hawthorne), California

**Minimum Requirements:**

* 2+ years of experience in an administrative role with high-volume scheduling; preferably in a fast-paced environment
* Track record of supporting multiple scheduling or customer needs at a time with a high level of urgency
* Strong customer service mindset; proven ability to provide a candidate-first mentality, prioritizing the candidate experience throughout the recruitment process
* Process-oriented mindset with a passion for process improvement, efficiency and organization
* Ability to connect and relate to a wide range of people, personalities, and values
* Ability to thrive in a constantly evolving environment with shifting priorities
* Willingness to work in-person out of our Los Angeles (Hawthorne) office location 5 days per week

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience using ATS applications; Greenhouse experience is highly preferred
* Experience scheduling within Microsoft Outlook
* Familiarity with Slack
* Interest in the Tech Recruiting/Talent Acquisition/People Operations function as a career path

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 450 employees and counting across 5 global offices

***Hourly Range: $28.00 - $36.00***

If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.*

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
**About Retail Reinvented**
---------------------------

Retail Reinvented helps brands and retailers succeed in the next era of commerce, the one where AI agents increasingly find, compare and buy products for shoppers.

We started as a hands-on retail and e-commerce advisory firm. We've rebuilt storefronts, re-platformed catalogs, fixed tracking and attribution, and run operations for brands that sell complex, made-to-order products. From that work we built **ConfigIQ**, our AI commerce platform. Our clients run their businesses on it today.

**Where we're headed.** Most commerce technology helps shoppers *find* products. Very little of it can confirm that the product a shopper or an AI agent configures can actually be built, priced and delivered. ConfigIQ is built to answer that question. It turns a company's product knowledge (options, compatibility rules, pricing and identity) into a trusted source of truth that websites, sales teams and AI shopping agents can all rely on. We call it the **system of validity** for modern commerce.

Over the next few years we're growing in three directions:

* **Platform:** expanding ConfigIQ from our first flagship clients to more brands and manufacturers with configurable, high-consideration products
* **Agentic commerce:** connecting our clients' catalogs to the new AI shopping channels, so every answer an agent gives about their products is accurate
* **Advisory:** continuing to guide clients through strategy, replatforming, marketing and operations, the hands-on work our platform grew out of

We're a small, senior team that moves fast, uses AI heavily in our own work, and c

**About the role**

We're a small, fast-moving AI commerce and advisory company, and we're looking for a capable, organized generalist to be the CEO's right hand. You'll keep the business running day to day across marketing, finance, people, clients and the office, so the CEO can focus on technology, new business and strategy.

This role suits someone who likes variety, can switch between tasks easily, and treats "that's not my job" as a foreign phrase. You won't be an expert in every area on day one. You do need to be resourceful, reliable and quick to learn.

**What you'll do**

**Executive support**

* Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, travel and inbox triage
* Prepare meeting agendas and briefing materials, and follow up on action items
* Act as the first point of contact for clients, partners and vendors

**Marketing & social media**

* Run our social channels (LinkedIn first): schedule posts, draft content, track engagement
* Coordinate email campaigns, website updates, events and marketing assets
* Keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint

**Accounting & bookkeeping**

* Keep the books (QuickBooks): categorize transactions, reconcile accounts, enter bills
* Handle invoicing, accounts receivable follow-up and accounts payable
* Prepare monthly reports for the CEO and work with our outside CPA on tax and year-end

**HR & recruiting**

* Post jobs, screen candidates, schedule interviews and coordinate offers
* Run new-hire onboarding and offboarding: paperwork, payroll setup, equipment and accounts
* Keep HR records, policies and benefits administration organized and compliant

**Account planning & client onboarding**

* Track accounts, renewals and pipeline in our CRM (HubSpot)
* Run new-client onboarding: contracts, kickoff scheduling, intake, access setup, welcome materials
* Help prepare account plans, proposals and quarterly client reviews

**Office management**

* Keep the office running: supplies, vendors, facilities and IT logistics
* Manage software subscriptions and tools, and set up access for new team members
* Plan team events and keep internal processes documented

### **Qualifications**

* 3+ years as an executive assistant, office manager, operations coordinator or in a similar role, ideally at a startup or small business
* Hands-on experience with bookkeeping software (QuickBooks preferred)
* Comfortable with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, a CRM, and social media scheduling tools
* Clear, professional writing, since you'll often communicate on the CEO's behalf
* Strong judgment and discretion with confidential financial, client and personnel information
* Highly organized, proactive, and able to juggle competing priorities without dropping things
* A builder's mindset: you notice a gap, write the process and make it run

**Nice to have:** Experience in SaaS, e-commerce or professional services; familiarity with AI tools; basic graphic design skills (Canva); HR or bookkeeping certification.

### **Why join**

* Work directly with the CEO and see how the whole business runs
* Broad exposure across marketing, finance, people and clients, which builds real business skills quickly
* Room to grow into an Operations Manager or Chief of Staff role as we scale

jobs.title: Account Manager III, Client Service Management
jobs.description:
The Client Service Manager role is a sales-incented, relationship-focused role responsible for helping drive growth across existing and prospective accounts. In partnership with the Account Manager, you will build relationships with Taft-Hartley trust funds, fund administrators, and other key stakeholders to understand their needs, identify opportunities, and connect them with solutions that support their goals.

This is a highly client-facing role, with regular in-person engagement with fund administrators and other key stakeholders to strengthen relationships, uncover opportunities, and provide insights that support account strategy and growth. A key component of this role is developing and maintaining strong relationships with Taft-Hartley trust funds, fund administrators, and other key decision makers and stakeholders. The successful candidate will be comfortable working within this environment, building credibility and trust, and engaging directly with administrators to understand their priorities and identify opportunities for growth.

Supports, identifies, and monitors priorities, deadlines, and expectations. Identifies, speaks up, and implements ways to address improvement opportunities for team.

jobs.title: Verizon Account Manager
jobs.description:
Primer Concepts is hiring an entry-level Verizon Account Manager to be assigned in Riverside, CA or nearby area. Never worked in sales before? That's okay. This is a true entry-level opportunity, and we'll teach you everything you need to know.

Primer Concepts partners directly with well-known brands like Verizon to run in-person sales campaigns. Our team works face-to-face with customers, representing our clients with honesty. We invest real time into training every entry-level Verizon Account Manager we bring on.

**A Day a Life of a Verizon Account Manager**

* Connect with customers in person and introduce Verizon plans and services
* Ask questions to understand what each customer needs before recommending anything
* Manage your own book of accounts, following up and building relationships over time
* Support existing customers while generating new sales in your assigned territory
* Log sales activity and customer notes accurately
* Partner with your team and leadership to hit shared sales targets
* Represent Primer Concepts and Verizon with transparency in every conversation

**Is This Entry-Level Role Right for You?**

* New to sales and want an entry-level path into a stable career
* Comfortable talking to people, including strangers
* Open to feedback and eager to learn, since this entry-level position comes with hands-on coaching
* Sales or customer service background helps, but isn't required for this entry-level opening
* Looking for more than an entry-level job, you want room to grow into a long-term sales career

***If you're looking for an honest entry-level way to break into sales, apply now to become our next Verizon Account Manager.***

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Key Customer Account Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.**  
  
**As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.**

**Job Summary:**  
Manages and develops assigned key customer accounts by serving as a trusted partner and advocate. Supports account growth through proactive engagement, strategic collaboration, and sales solutions that align with customer needs. Coordinates internally to ensure accurate order fulfillment, service delivery, and issue resolution. Applies working knowledge of products and construction industry solutions to strengthen customer retention and account performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Serves as the primary liason for assigned key accounts, building and maintaining long-term customer relationships.
  
Supports account growth by identifying upselling and cross-selling expanding the network of relationships, and partnering with customers early to understand short and long-term business needs.
  
Coordinates with internal teams to support accurate procurement, delivery, service, and billing for customers.
  
Tracks and reports on account performance metrics, and identifies additional partnership opportunities.
  
Acts as a customer advocate by resolving service or delivery issues and communicating updates and recommendations.
  
Applies product knowledge and construction‑industry expertise to offer practical, innovative solutions.
  
  
**Education Qualifications:**  
Bachelor’s degree in business, construction management, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.
  
  
**Work Experience:**  
3–5 years of experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles required.
  
2-3+ years of construction supply and rental equipment industry knowledge preferred.
  
  
**Certifications and Licenses:**  
None required.

DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world.

  
  

Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek.

  
  

Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

jobs.title: Remote-Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Remote Customer Success Lead is a critical frontline leader and subject matter expert responsible for managing complex, urgent, and high-visibility member escalations including executive-level escalations. Reporting directly to the Supervisor, Customer Success, this role operates as a “working lead,” balancing direct member interaction with team support and operational oversight.  
This role requires strong ownership, sound judgment, and a deep commitment to service recovery excellence. The Lead is accountability for resolving escalations end-to-end, especially those that are sensitive, time-critical, or impactful to senior leadership, while consistently delivering empathetic, compassionate, and human-centered experiences  
In close partnership with frontline Specialists, the Lead provides real-time guidance, removes barriers, and ensures high-quality, timely resolution aligned with organizational standards, regulatory requirements, service expectations and caring connections.

**Job Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Escalation Ownership & Service Recovery Excellence**

* Take full ownership of complex, urgent, and high-visibility member escalations, including executive and market leader cases, ensuring timely and complete resolution.
* Lead service recovery efforts with a focus on empathy, active listening, and restoring member trust through meaningful and caring interactions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for sensitive or escalated issues, demonstrating accountability from intake through resolution.
* Ensure all escalation responses are accurate, compliant, and aligned with organizational tone and quality expectations.
* Partner cross-functionally to remove barriers and drive resolution for escalations that require coordination across departments.

**Operational Support Responsibilities**

* Maintain a “working” role by handling inbound and outbound member interactions in alignment with departmental productivity and service level goals.
* Support daily triage and prioritization of escalation cases, ensuring appropriate assignment and timely follow-up.
* Monitor active cases to ensure adherence to SLAs, quality standards, and service recovery expectations.
* Address complaints and grievances in accordance with Medicare Managed Care requirements and internal procedures.

**Frontline Team Support & Enablement**

* Serve as a subject matter expert and primary resource for Specialists, providing real-time guidance, coaching, and escalation support.
* Actively support frontline Specialists in navigating complex cases, reinforcing an ownership mindset and high standards of member care.
* Foster a culture of empathy and accountability across the team.
* Assist with onboarding, including nesting support, live call monitoring, and guidance to ensure readiness and confidence.

**Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement**

* Assist in monitoring individual and team performance across productivity, quality, and service metrics.
* Identify trends in escalations and member feedback; provide insights and recommendations to leadership.
* Partner with Training and leadership to identify skill gaps and support ongoing development initiatives.
* Contribute to process improvement efforts aimed at reducing escalations, efficiencies and improving the overall member experience.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Collaborate closely with the Supervisor, Customer Success to ensure alignment of priorities, escalations, and team performance.
* Maintain clear, professional, and effective communication with internal stakeholders, including leadership and cross-functional partners.
* Support reporting needs related to escalation trends, risks, and service recovery outcomes.

**Compliance & Confidentiality**

* Maintain strict adherence to HIPAA, privacy, and data security standards.
* Ensure all member interactions and case documentation meet regulatory and organizational compliance requirements.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Assist with monitoring attendance and schedule adherence.
* Encourage a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Supports the Supervisor, Customer Success in the day-to-day oversight of team operations. Assists with planning and monitoring work; provides input on performance, as needed. Acts as a role model and leader within the team, particularly in handling escalations and supporting frontline staff.

**Job Requirements:**

**Experience:**

* Required:
  + Strong knowledge of Medicare Managed Care plans required
  + 3+ years of customer service experience required (healthcare preferred)
  + Previous Lead or equivalent experience required
* Preferred:
  + Experience handling complex or executive-level escalations strongly preferred
  + Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred

**Education:**

* Required: High school diploma or GED with relevant work experience
* Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field with relevant work experience

**Training:**

* Required: None

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Power BI
* Experience with Microsoft Teams and case management systems

jobs.title: Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**Exciting opportunity to be eligible for a $5,500 bonus when you join our team.**

As a **Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts,** you will own and grow a portfolio of complex, high-growth Medium Business customers while developing new opportunities across assigned accounts. These customers are expanding, evolving, and navigating increasingly complex technology decisions, requiring a consultative seller who can build trust, uncover business needs, and position solutions that create measurable value. This is a strategic, quota-carrying outside sales role for an experienced B2B seller who can balance account maintenance, service coordination, prospecting, pipeline creation, and complex solution selling. You will work closely with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, and cross-functional teams to help customers evaluate technology choices, solve business challenges, and invest in solutions that support long-term growth. This role is designed for sellers who are technical, resourceful, disciplined, and comfortable competing in a sophisticated market where customers have more choices than ever.

**Earn with confidence and upside.** This role offers a competitive base salary as well as performance-based commission tied directly to your sales results. At 100% of target, **annual earnings range from $116,700 – $147,500.** If you are motivated by ownership, measurable goals, and the ability to increase your income through performance, this role is designed for you.

**What you’ll do**

* **Balance field and office collaboration:** When not in the field, sales employees are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location and place of work.
* **Own and grow Platinum level accounts.** Build account plans that prioritize retention, expansion, new opportunity creation, customer relationship depth, and long-term revenue growth.
* **Balance service and sales priorities.** Manage account maintenance and customer service needs while protecting time for prospecting, pipeline development, and closing new business.
* **Create and manage strategic pipelines.** Generate opportunities through account mapping, executive outreach, referrals, partner collaboration, customer expansion plays, and targeted prospecting.
* **Navigate complex technical solutions.** Learn and position wired, mobility, connectivity, and advanced technology solutions while translating technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* **Orchestrate internal and partner resources.** Collaborate with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, product specialists, and support teams to design and deliver the right customer solution.
* **Differentiate in a competitive market.** Compete against direct providers, indirect competitors, vendors, resellers, and internal channel overlap by selling value, relationship, expertise, and business impact.
* **Lead a consultative sales process.** Diagnosing customer needs, uncover growth opportunities, overcome objections, and build solutions aligned to operational, technology, and financial priorities.
* **Maintain disciplined CRM and forecast accuracy.** Track pipeline, account activity, deal stage, next steps, expected close timing, and revenue impact with consistency and accuracy.
* **Protect customer relationships.** Serve as a trusted business advisor who can coordinate across service, sales, technical, and partner resources to help customers succeed.

**What you’ll Bring**

  

* 5+ years of successful outside B2B sales experience, preferably with complex accounts, telecommunications, technology, SaaS, mobility, wired solutions, or business services.
* Documented success meeting or exceeding quota in a full-cycle sales role that required prospecting, account growth, negotiation, and closing.
* Ability to manage both sales and account-maintenance demands without losing focus on pipeline creation and revenue growth.
* Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex product sets, internal processes, wired and mobility terminology, and solution-design concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to work through internal teams, sales engineers, partner channels, and cross-functional resources to solve customer problems.
* Strong territory, account planning, pipeline management, prioritization, and forecasting discipline.
* Comfortable competing in a market where customers evaluate multiple providers, vendors, resellers, and channel options.
* Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and reliable transportation for market coverage.
* Bachelor’s degree is preferred, or equivalent combination of relevant sales experience and demonstrated performance.

Join a sales organization where complex account ownership, technical growth, and customer impact matter. In Platinum, you will manage meaningful business relationships, compete in a sophisticated market, and partner across sales engineering, mobility, wired, indirect, and support teams to solve customer problems. This role is designed for experienced sellers who want more than transactional selling: it offers the challenge of balancing account strategy, service demands, technical solutioning, and new revenue growth. In addition to competitive pay and commission, AT&T offers paid training, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, wellness programs, and career development resources designed to support long-term success.

**Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act**

Candidates with arrest or convictions records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Relevant Material Job Duties for which Criminal History may have a direct adverse, and negative relationship potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the Conditional Offer of Employment:

* Contact with Customers/

jobs.title: Independent Sales Representative Performance-Based Compensation
jobs.description:
**Independent Contractor | Defined Territory | Field-Based**

Growing a food and beverage business takes more than introducing a product. It takes understanding what customers will buy, helping operators select the right assortment, and following through so new placements become repeat orders.

G & J Marketing and Sales is looking for an experienced, self-directed salesperson based in Los Angeles, CA to actively cover the territory across vending, micro markets, office coffee, and pantry service.

The territory includes existing customer relationships and business already generating commissions. You will represent nationally recognized brands, develop those accounts, and pursue new business. Your earnings will reflect the sales you generate and actively service.

**About G & J**

G & J Marketing and Sales has represented leading manufacturers to operators, distributors, and national accounts in Vending, Micro Markets, and OCS across North America since 1984. Our success is directly tied to the business we generate for the manufacturers we represent.

**What You Will Own**

**Develop New Business**  
Identify prospective customers, arrange meetings, and secure new product placements. Present food and beverage options that fit each customer’s operation, consumer preferences, and sales goals.

**Grow Existing Accounts**  
Understand what each account purchases and where there is room to expand. Introduce additional products, support relevant promotions, and follow up on results to build repeat business.

**Manage Customer Relationships**  
Stay in regular contact with operators and distributors. Understand their priorities, respond to questions, and coordinate with G & J and manufacturer partners to address issues that affect sales.

**Represent Our Manufacturer Partners**  
Know the products, pricing, and programs you represent. Give customers accurate information and work with G & J’s National Sales Managers on opportunities that need additional supplier support.

**Manage Your Territory**  
Determine your daily schedule, sales approach, priorities, and methods within the defined territory and applicable brand standards. Keep customer activity and opportunities current in the CRM, and use sales reports to guide account follow-up.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* Retain and grow the existing business within the territory
* Add customers and expand product distribution within current accounts
* Turn new placements and promotions into repeat purchases
* Maintain a current pipeline and follow through on customer commitments
* Grow territory sales and commission earnings through active account development

**Who This Role Is Ideal For**

This role is suited to an experienced salesperson who enjoys working directly with customers and wants to manage a defined territory independently.

You are comfortable asking for the business, following up after a meeting, and staying involved after the first order. You recognize opportunities within existing accounts as well as with new customers.

Experience with CPG, foodservice, vending, office coffee, or distribution is valuable. You understand how product selection, availability, and consistent service influence a customer’s buying decisions.

You can organize your work without daily direction and are comfortable with earnings tied to sales performance. You want an established customer base to develop while taking responsibility for the business you build.

**Experience and Skills**

* Proven success in sales, account management, and new business development
* Ability to grow and manage a defined sales territory independently
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and customer communication skills
* Organization and consistent follow-through across multiple accounts and opportunities
* Comfort using CRM tools, sales reports, and virtual meetings to support field sales
* Experience in CPG, foodservice, brokerage, or related channels; local industry relationships a plus

**Compensation Structure**

This is a sales performance role with commission-based compensation tied to the sales you generate and actively service. The territory includes existing business already generating commissions, with additional earning potential through new accounts, expanded distribution, and growth within current customers.

That’s why we’re committed to living our values every day: inspiring, achieving, and connecting as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.

Building for the long-term means that all of our team members can expect to work on amazing projects with a people-first approach to problem solving. It also means that each member of our team has truly limitless potential to build a unique, meaningful, and high-impact career—and they’ll receive great total rewards along the way.

Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We know that tomorrow’s requirements are today’s opportunities, and we are here to design lasting solutions for pressing challenges.

We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high-rise buildings, clean energy, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more.

Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to life every day.

The Engineering Project Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting the successful delivery of healthcare and commercial engineering projects through construction administration, field coordination, project delivery, and technical support activities.

This position serves as a liaison between engineering teams, project managers, contractors, clients, and field personnel throughout design and construction. The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of construction processes, project execution, and contractor coordination, with the ability to contribute practical field knowledge that enhances project delivery and constructability.

The Engineering Project Coordinator supports projects from planning through closeout while developing increasing technical knowledge of building systems, engineering design processes, and consulting engineering practices.

* Lead and coordinate construction administration activities for assigned projects.
* Lead assigned construction administration meetings and coordination activities within the defined project scope.
* Communicate project requirements and follow-up actions clearly to contractors, consultants, clients, and internal team members.
* Provide day-to-day coordination and direction for assigned CA activities while escalating design decisions and contractual issues to the Project Manager or Engineer of Record.
* Attend project meetings, site visits, pre-construction conferences, and owner coordination meetings.
* Track and facilitate the review of RFIs, submittals, change requests, and construction issues.

* Monitor construction progress and communicate project status updates to project teams.

* Perform drawing revisions and project-document updates under the direction of the Engineer of Record or Project Manager.

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. jobs.description:

The Customer Sales and Experience Specialist is the first and last impression of the salon, responsible for creating a welcoming, professional, and elevated experience for every guest. This role ensures smooth front desk operations, accurate appointment scheduling, and prompt, courteous service. In addition to supporting the salon team and resolving client concerns, the Customer Sales and Experience Specialist plays a key role in driving salon success by confidently recommending and selling retail products that support each guest's hair routine. By combining exceptional customer service with product knowledge and sales focus, this role helps build client trust, boost revenue and reinforces the salon's commitment to delivering expert care beyond the chair.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Sales**

* Proactively recommends retail products based on guests' needs, stylist consultation and seasonal promotions.
* Achieves or exceeds individual retail sales goals and contribute to overall salon sales targets.
* Educates guests on the benefits and usage of products to support their at-home care routine.
* Partners with stylists to reinforce product recommendations during checkout.
* Supports the execution of in-salon promotions, product launches and limited time offers.
* Actively supports daily, weekly, and monthly retail goals by educating guests and upselling salon products which need to also result in meeting the minimum productivity expectations for the CSES position.
* Drives retail sales by recommending products that align with guest needs and stylist consultation while utilizing FindMore when appropriate.
* Encourages guest rebooking and promotes JCPenney Rewards and Credit Card acquisition and usage.

**Customer Service**

* Greets every guest with warmth and professionalism, creating a welcoming and memorable first impression.
* Engages and actively listens; ensures guests feel supported, and excited to return.
* Delivers a seamless and personalized experience throughout the guest's visit, ensuring satisfaction from check-in to check-out.
* Communicates effectively with guests to confirm appointments and answer questions.
* Supports a positive team environment by collaborating with stylists, managers, and fellow Customer Experience Specialists.
* Upholds a high standard of hospitality that reflects the salon's commitment to quality in every detail.

**General Operations**

* Meets or exceeds company attendance and on-time standards.
* Participates in ongoing skills development through company and/or vendor provided training and skill practice.
* Promotes and supports events that drive traffic, client engagement, and service bookings.
* Participates in team meetings and training to stay aligned with salon goals.
* Ensures front desk operations run smoothly, including accurate scheduling, guest check in and out and payment processing.
* Upholds salon cleanliness and organization standards within front desk and salon retail area.
* Handles phone and in person inquiries with efficiency and professionalism.
* Supports inventory management by tracking product levels, restocking retail shelves and alerting leadership of low stock.
* Follows salon policies and procedures, including safety, sanitation, and compliance protocols.

**Qualifications:**

* **Passion for Salon**: A love for product and salon services. An understanding of the client's benefits from products and a variety of salon services.
* **Results:** Solve problems and make smart decisions that drive sales, profit, and customer service; execute work efficiently and effectively; inspire strong performance in yourself and others.
* **Ownership:** Provide great customer service; cooperate and build positive, inclusive, and respectful relationships; take accountability for your actions and outcomes.
* **Intensity:** Proactively find ways to improve the customer experience; show the confidence and courage to do what is right; act with energy and urgency.

**What you get:**

If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\*, and 401(k) with Company match. All associates are eligible for an associate discount on JCPenney merchandise. For paid holidays, associates who are eligible for paid vacation (MTO) are also eligible for eight paid holidays during the calendar year. All store hourly associates scheduled to work on a designated holiday will receive additional compensation. \*For paid vacation days, as well as eligibility requirements for other benefits, please visit www.catalystbrandsbenefits.com

JCPenney is the shopping destination for diverse, working American families. With inclusivity at its core, the Company's product assortment meets customers' everyday needs and helps them commemorate every special occasion with style, quality, and value. JCPenney offers a broad portfolio of fashion, apparel, home, beauty, and jewelry from national and private brands and provides personal services including salon, portrait and optical. The Company and its 50,000 associates worldwide serve customers where, when, and how they want to shop - from jcp.com to more than 650 stores in the U.S. and Puerto Rico. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  
  
**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at TriNet you will serve as the face of a well established, reputable company that empowers the small business community to focus on what matters most – growing their business. This individual is often the first line of communication between TriNet and prospective clients as the person responsible for identifying, contacting and qualifying opportunities for the sales organization to generate new business. This role, coupled with TriNet emphasis on continuous learning and defined career paths, will lay the foundation for a successful sales career. If you are somebody looking to accelerate your sales development career with a high growth, stable company and rewarding mission, then come join us!  
  
**What you will do**

* Secure meetings with the right people, at the right place, at the right time to create high quality sales opportunities for the field sales team.

* The focus each day for our SDRs is getting connected with decision makers, extending the conversation, and securing meetings for our field sales team.

* Use internal sales tools and resources to execute a high touch sales cadence on prospects.

* Make around 80 cold calls a day to prospects to gauge interest.

* Initiate contact with prospects through a multi-channel outbound prospecting strategy using phone calls, email, and LinkedIn.

* Attend meetings you’ve scheduled and conduct routine check-ins with your Sales Consultant to receive feedback on the opportunities you have created.

* Execute a follow-up strategy on prospects that were not interested but maybe in the future or were interested but did not buy.

* Develop new sales strategies based on personal successes and failures and share what’s working with your peers!

* Performs other duties as assigned

* Complies with all policies and standards

**Education Qualifications**

* High School Diploma required or

* Bachelor's Degree preferred

**Experience Qualifications**

* Typically, < 1 year Sales prospecting and research preferred

**Skills and Abilities**

* Articulate and persuasive written and oral communicator (Intermediate proficiency)

* Demonstrate willingness to grow through discomfort – fearless! (Intermediate proficiency)

* Seeks out, internalizes, and applies coaching feedback (Intermediate proficiency)

* Strong work ethic and self-drive (Intermediate proficiency)

* A believer in the fruits of a disciplined process (Intermediate proficiency)

* Strong attention to detail and highly organized (Intermediate proficiency)

* Great active-listening skills (Intermediate proficiency)

* Ability to maintain a positive attitude in the face of rejection and failure (Intermediate proficiency)

* Enjoys collaborating with internal and cross-functional teams (Intermediate proficiency)

* Strong computer literacy skills (Intermediate proficiency)

* Experience using a CRM; Salesforce preferred (Intermediate proficiency)

* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace (Intermediate proficiency)

**Travel Requirements**  
Minimal  
  
**Work Environment**

* Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable office or home setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The preferred location for this role is Irvine, CA, and the salary range for this location is $22.00 to $27.69. All qualified external applicants will be considered for an in-office role, based in Irvine. All qualified internal candidates are encouraged to apply and consider relocation to Irvine and may be considered for remote hire at the company’s discretion. The candidate’s final salary offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, education, work location and experience.

Candidates hired into roles in the sales organization are also eligible for commissions consistent with TriNet’s commission plan.

Additionally, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, TriNet offers permanent full-time employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(K) savings plan, an employee stock purchase plan, eleven (11) Company observed holidays, PTO and a comprehensive leave program. Please click the following link for detailed information about our benefits offerings: https://www.trinet.com/documents/blt5b6

jobs.title: Resident Services Coordinator/Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a full-time, highly motivated **Resident Services Coordinator & After-School Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Formal Job Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, Full-Time 34 hours per week (14 hours per week Director of Social Services/20 hours per week Program Coordinator)
* **Job location:** Oakland/Alameda, CA
* **Pay: $21.00 per hour (Program Coordinator), $28.35-$30.00 per hour (Director of Social Services)**

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator / Content Creator
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Monarch Plumbing & Rooter, Inc. is a growing local plumbing company committed to providing reliable service and high-quality solutions to our customers. As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a creative, motivated, and highly efficient Marketing Coordinator / Content & Brand Specialist to take an active role in developing and managing our company's marketing.

We are looking for someone who can bring fresh ideas, think outside the box, and help us continue building a strong and recognizable brand.

**Position Overview**

This is a hands-on marketing position responsible for supporting and managing all aspects of Monarch Plumbing & Rooter's marketing—from our online presence and social media to photography, video production, advertising, printed materials, field marketing, branding, and community outreach.

A major part of this position will involve creating original photo and video content. This individual should be comfortable going into the field, photographing and recording our technicians, projects, equipment, company events, before-and-after work, and other content that can be used to market the company.

The person in this position will also be responsible for turning that raw content into professional, engaging marketing material through photo editing, video editing, graphic design, and content creation.

We are looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for marketing assignments. We want someone who can identify opportunities, develop ideas, and take those ideas from concept through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist with developing and executing the company's overall marketing strategy.
* Manage the company's social media presence and content calendar.
* Create, schedule, and publish engaging social media content.
* Photograph and record company projects, technicians, equipment, events, and other marketing opportunities.
* Travel to local job sites when needed to capture high-quality photos and video content.
* Plan and produce before-and-after content, project highlights, educational videos, employee features, promotional videos, and other creative content.
* Edit photos and videos for social media, advertising, website content, and other marketing materials.
* Create short-form video content such as Instagram Reels, TikTok-style videos, and other social media content.
* Maintain an organized library of company photos, videos, graphics, and other marketing assets.
* Develop graphics, flyers, brochures, mailers, advertisements, signage, and promotional materials.
* Help maintain and improve the company's presence across Google, Yelp, social media, and other online platforms.
* Assist with website content and identify opportunities to improve the company's online presence.
* Develop marketing campaigns and promotions to help generate leads and increase customer engagement.
* Maintain consistent company branding across digital platforms, vehicles, uniforms, signage, printed materials, and advertising.
* Assist with email and customer marketing campaigns.
* Help develop strategies to increase positive customer reviews and online engagement.
* Research local advertising, sponsorship, partnership, and community outreach opportunities.
* Assist with company events, community events, sponsorships, and promotional activities.
* Research competitors and current marketing trends to identify new opportunities.
* Track marketing campaigns and results to determine what is generating leads and producing results.
* Work closely with office staff, management, and field technicians to identify and create marketing opportunities.
* Take ownership of marketing projects from initial idea through completion.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Previous experience in marketing, content creation, social media, or a related field.
* Photography experience and a strong understanding of how to capture professional-quality images.
* Videography experience and the ability to confidently record high-quality video content.
* Experience with photo and video editing software.
* Ability to create polished, engaging content from raw photos and video footage.
* Experience creating content for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
* Graphic design experience and familiarity with programs such as Canva, Adobe or similar design platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Comfortable working with Google Workspace and other digital platforms.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Comfortable working both in an office environment and visiting job sites to capture content.

**Additional Skills That Are a Plus**

Experience in any of the following areas is a plus:

* Digital advertising and paid social media campaigns
* Google Ads
* Google Business Profile
* Yelp business marketing
* SEO and local search marketing
* Website content management
* Email marketing
* Graphic design
* Branding and brand development
* Marketing analytics and performance tracking
* Community outreach and event marketing
* Home-service, construction, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or similar service-industry marketing

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is creative, highly efficient, resourceful, organized, and proactive.

This person should have a creative eye and be able to recognize marketing opportunities in everyday company operations. Whether it's a technician completing an interesting project, a before-and-after transformation, new equipment arriving, a community event, or an opportunity to educate customers, we want someone who can recognize that opportunity and turn it into quality content.

The ideal candidate:

* Thinks creatively and outside the box.
* Has a strong eye for photography, video, design, and visual presentation.
* Understands how to create content that captures people's attention

jobs.description:
**About OpenAI**
----------------

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products.

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Global Events Systems & Operations Coordinator will help maintain the trackers, templates, reporting views, and documentation that help OpenAI’s Global Events team manage work across regions and programs. This is a contract role with a 6-month term, reporting to the Events Operations Manager.

The role combines day-to-day workflow coordination with practical process improvement. You will keep Events records accurate, coordinate contract and purchase request submissions, track budgets and payment status, and implement agreed improvements using tools such as Airtable, Zip, Planned, and Google Workspace.

You will own the Events side of these workflows, partnering with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Accounts Payable, who retain responsibility for their respective processes, reviews, and approvals. The Events Operations Manager will set priorities across competing requests.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and comfortable following work through to completion across multiple stakeholders. They enjoy improving how teams work and using approved AI tools to reduce repetitive administrative tasks.

Candidates must be based in San Francisco and work from the office three days per week.

**In This Role, You Will**
--------------------------

* Maintain Events trackers, templates, reporting views, and workflow guidance in Airtable, Zip, Planned, and Google Workspace.
* Coordinate contract and purchase requests with Procurement and Legal; check invoice submissions for complete, consistent documentation.
* Track budgets, commitments, invoices, and payment status with Event Managers, Finance, and Accounts Payable; flag discrepancies and support reconciliation.
* Coordinate vendor onboarding and cross-functional handoffs, keeping owners, deadlines, and next steps clear.
* Follow through on outstanding actions, provide concise Slack updates, and escalate blockers or competing priorities to the Events Operations Manager.
* Implement agreed workflow improvements and use approved AI tools, including ChatGPT and Codex, to reduce repetitive work while protecting accuracy and confidentiality.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have**
---------------------------------------------

* At least 2 years of experience in events operations, systems coordination, project coordination, or a related operational support role.
* Experience maintaining shared trackers, templates, and documentation while coordinating multiple projects and deadlines.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and attention to detail, including checking records for completeness and reconciling information across systems.
* Experience coordinating purchase requests, invoice submissions, or budget tracking, with an understanding of approval workflows.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to follow up effectively across internal teams and external vendors.
* The ability to work independently within established processes, identify issues, and escalate when guidance or a decision is needed.
* Experience using ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI tools, and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Interest in OpenAI’s mission and improving how teams work through technology.
* Familiarity with Airtable, Zip, Planned, Google Workspace, and Slack is a plus, as is experience supporting global events or marketing operations.

* **Maintain accurate records:** Update inventory sheets, delivery logs, checklists, and other operational documents.
* **Handle daily administration:** Manage data entry, filing, schedules, and follow-ups to keep kitchen operations organized.

**Required qualifications**

* Previous administrative, purchasing, inventory, or operations experience within the restaurant or food industry.
* Familiarity with food ingredients, kitchen terminology, recipe measurements, and inventory handling.
* Strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets, accurate data entry, and digital file organization.
* Ability to learn recipe management, inventory, and ordering software.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly with quantities, units, product names, and recipe versions.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and follow through in a busy kitchen environment.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. * Coordinate drivers, vehicles, transportation, and arrival times.

* Lead or oversee event setup, service, and breakdown.
