jobs.title: Patient account manager
jobs.description:
**About Serova**

Serova is building a fast-growing clinical network for its personalised cancer vaccine programme. Each vaccine is made for the individual patient from their own samples and given in partnership with their treating physician. We run the whole process for patients and their oncologists, from initial review through treatment and follow-up.

**The role**

We're looking for a Patient Account Manager to own each patient's experience from sign-up through to administration and follow-up. You'll be the main point of contact for the patient, their family, their physician and, where separate, the treatment sponsor-investigator. You'll answer their questions and keep every step on track.

Success looks like an excellent experience for every patient in our care, and a patient journey that runs smoothly and on time.

**What you'll do**

* Guide new patients and families through sign-up, consent paperwork, records requests and what to expect at each stage
* Coordinate sample collection and shipping with the patient's physician, pathology labs and sequencing partners, and track each sample through to results and analysis
* Keep patients, families and physicians regularly updated on sequencing, manufacturing and administration dates
* Answer non-clinical questions yourself, and quickly pass clinical or medical questions to our nursing, medical or scientific team
* Keep accurate, confidential records of each patient's status, communications and outstanding actions
* Arrange practical support such as travel, scheduling and help with financial-access questions

**Your first few months**

* Get to know Serova's personalised cancer vaccine programme end to end, from both our side and the patient's
* Take over communication and day-to-day management of patients already on the programme
* Set up patient trackers and make sure every outstanding action and question is dealt with

**What we're looking for**

* Experience in a patient-facing coordination role, such as patient services, case management, care coordination or clinical-trial patient support, ideally in oncology. If you've done similar work outside a clinical setting and have the right mindset, we'd still like to hear from you.
* A track record of managing complex, time-sensitive logistics across several external parties, such as clinics, labs and couriers
* Clear, compassionate communication with patients and families during a difficult time, and confidence working with physicians and their teams
* Careful handling of confidential health information, with working knowledge of HIPAA
* Good judgement about which questions to answer yourself and which to escalate to clinical colleagues

**Nice to have**

* Experience with personalised or autologous therapy programmes
* Specimen chain of custody
* Expanded-access or clinical-trial enrolment
* Patient CRM or case-management systems
* Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP)

**Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco, California
* **Type:** Full-time
* **Salary:** $100,000 to $130,000

Questions? Email clinical@serova.bio

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description:
**Psychological Assessment, Inc.**

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Executive Assistant to support our CEO, a senior psychologist and forensic neuropsychologist whose practice centers on assessment and testifying in court as an expert witness. In this role, you will be the person who makes a demanding clinical and executive schedule work — protecting time, anticipating needs, coordinating schedules, developing relationships with multiple medical groups, attorneys, and others, ensuring compliance with license/certification renewal, and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks. You will manage calendars and correspondence, coordinate the logistics of assessment referrals and appointments, support the production and delivery of assessment reports, and track records and billing follow-up. * Demonstrated ability to manage a complex calendar and competing priorities without dropping commitments
* Excellent written communication, with strong proofreading skills and genuine care for accuracy
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and the Microsoft Office suite; comfort learning new practice-management and scheduling tools
* Absolute discretion with confidential and sensitive information, and a working understanding of confidentiality obligations in a clinical setting (HIPAA familiarity preferred)
* Sound judgment about what to escalate, what to handle independently, and what can wait
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a greater team
* A proactive posture: anticipating needs and acting before problems escalate, rather than waiting for direction

* Reliable, punctual, and consistently present

jobs.description:
Are you a recent college grad or professional looking to transform lives through medical communications? Are you ready for a rewarding career in a collaborative and growing environment? We're hiring a savvy **Program Coordinator** passionate about keeping projects on task and their team focused.

**About You**

* You are flexible and confident you can manage up to 20 projects at a time and be responsible for the project development process.
* You are solution-oriented and can anticipate potential workflow obstacles and provide solutions.
* You're highly organized, a self-starter with an eye for the details and a pulse on the bottom line.
* You flourish in fast-paced environments and relish the particulars.
* You work passionately, never satisfied with the status quo.
* You're a born problem-solver and enjoy when no day is the same.

**Your Day-to-Day**

As a Program Coordinator, you will track project deliverables through all departments, ensure due dates are relayed, and obstacles are identified and communicated efficiently. You will be responsible for running your clients medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) process. This includes submissions, coordinating with taggers, and communicating status updates to the client, the MLR Supervisor, and your supporting team. In addition, you will oversee coordinating internal and external meeting, taking meeting notes during meetings, and providing status updates to the team.

Under supervision from a program manager, you will review invoicing documents and final reconciliations, prepare Sunshine Act reports and any ancillary reports as required by the client. You will work closely with the logistics vendor to perform meeting planning tasks, including site search, venue contracting, travel arrangements, food/beverage, and AV equipment. You will be responsible for preparing and distributing the assignment report and facilitating assignment team meetings.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor's degree, ideally with a concentration in advertising, marketing, communications, or journalism; other majors will be considered
* 0-2 years of prior work experience in a client service/agency setting or related internship experience
* A high level of computer competency and intermediate or advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, and Outlook)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Helpful Experience**

* Working knowledge of timeline and schedule development
* Experience supporting a project manager or marketing team with coordinating tasks and tracking deadlines

**Who We Are**

Precision AQ - Medical Communications was founded with the simple belief that the scientific story is the foundation of every pharmaceutical brand. Our teams of inquisitive problem solvers and passionate creators dig deep to translate the science behind today's cutting-edge therapies, then communicate the science clearly and credibly. jobs.title: Events & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Events & Administrative Coordinator

**Reports to:** Managing Director, Development

**About Commonpoint:**

Rooted in community and driven by possibility, Commonpoint meets the evolving needs of New Yorkers at every stage of life. More than 125,000 people turn to Commonpoint each year through our eleven flagship locations and nearly 100 co located program sites – for opportunities to learn and thrive, support in moments of crisis, and pathways to stronger, more secure futures.

From early childhood through older adulthood, Commonpoint is there for everyday life – and for the moments when life gets hard. Rooted in Jewish values, we serve New Yorkers of all backgrounds and abilities, creating opportunities to learn, play, connect and belong while helping individuals and families navigate challenges with the support and resources they need.

**Position Summary:**

The Events & Administrative Coordinator provides administrative, operational, and event support across Commonpoint’s Development division, which brings together fundraising and donor engagement, volunteerism, and Jewish heritage and cultural arts. The Coordinator works across these areas to support the planning and execution of events, programs, fundraising activities, and other team priorities.

A significant focus of the role is event and program planning and logistics – from advance planning and coordination through day-of execution and follow-up. This includes volunteer programs, donor cultivation and stewardship events, fundraising events, and cultural arts programs.

The Coordinator also supports the division’s day-to-day operations, including data and database management, donor administration, mailings and campaign execution, materials production, and other administrative needs. The Coordinator helps develop and maintain systems, tools, and processes that strengthen team organization and efficiency, while keeping projects, information, and logistics organized and moving forward across the division.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Event & Program Logistics:** Coordinates the planning and logistics for volunteer programs, donor cultivation and stewardship events, fundraising events, and cultural arts programs, including managing timelines, registration, vendors, purchasing and organizing materials and supplies, room setup, catering, day-of logistics, and other operational needs.
* **Administrative & Team Support:** Provides day-to-day administrative and logistical support across the Development team, including scheduling meetings as needed, preparing materials, organizing files, processing invoices and expenses, coordinating orders and deliveries, supporting team meetings and other convenings, and assisting with other administrative and logistical needs as they arise.
* **Systems & Workflow Coordination**: Helps develop, implement, and maintain tools, workflows, templates, and processes that strengthen team organization, coordination, and efficiency; helps track timelines, deadlines, and outstanding tasks and identifies opportunities to streamline routine administrative and operational work.
* **Data & Information Management:** Enters and updates donor, prospect, event, volunteer, and other Development information in the CRM and related systems; supports accurate recordkeeping, list management, and routine data cleanup; and maintains organized, up-to-date files and materials on the Development team’s shared drive.
* **Campaign & Mailing Execution**: Coordinates the logistical execution of fundraising campaigns and mailings, including preparing lists and materials, coordinating printing and mail houses, tracking production timelines, and ensuring materials are produced and distributed on schedule.
* **Gift & Donor Administration**: Supports gift processing and donor administration as needed, including entering gifts, preparing and mailing acknowledgment materials, maintaining donor records, and assisting with routine donor-related administrative needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in administrative support, operations, event planning, project coordination, or a related area; nonprofit experience a plus.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong follow-through, problem-solving skills, and ability to take ownership of tasks from start to finish.
* Comfortable working with data and maintaining accurate records; experience with DonorPerfect or another CRM/database preferred.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office, including spreadsheets, shared drives, calendars, and other collaborative tools.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with colleagues, vendors, volunteers, donors, and other stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
* Willingness to take on a wide range of administrative and logistical tasks and provide hands-on support where needed.
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends for events and programs.

**Work Environment:**

This position is in-person, with local travel required.

**Physical Demands:**

May need to lift/carry up to 25 pounds of boxes.

**Salary/Benefits:**

Commonpoint offers compensation commensurate with skills and experience and includes a competitive benefits package. Salary for this position will be between $50,000-$58,000.

**Location:** Commonpoint Sam Field Center (58-20 Little Neck Parkway, Little Neck, 11362) or Central Queens (67-09 108th Street, Forest Hills 11375) or Midtown Manhattan (35 West 31st Street, 4th Floor, New York, NY 10001).

**FLSA Status:** Full-Time, Exempt.

**Schedule:** Monday-Friday, 9:00 am - 5:00 pm with some evenings and weekends required for events.

jobs.title: E-commerce Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Maure**

Maure is a New York-based gifting brand founded by chef Maureen Cavalieri. We sell curated gift sets alongside several hundred individual pieces across kitchen and dining, home decor, fragrance, and office.

Some products are designed and produced under our own label with specialist manufacturers in Europe, while others are sourced from makers and artisans around the world. Customers can purchase a ready-made gift set, build their own, or shop individual pieces.

We sell directly to customers through our Shopify website and wholesale to retailers through Faire.

We are a small team, which means the work is broad, visible, and moves quickly.

**The Role**

We are looking for an E-commerce Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day operation and presentation of Maure's online store.

This is primarily a **Shopify-focused e-commerce role**, not a social media or traditional marketing position.

The core of the role is maintaining and merchandising the website: adding new products, updating product information and imagery, building collections and landing pages, refreshing homepage content, supporting product launches, and making sure the site is accurate, organized, and visually strong.

You will also manage the execution of Maure's email program through Klaviyo, including building approximately two campaigns per week, preparing imagery and copy, scheduling campaigns, and ensuring emails align with current products, inventory, launches, and seasonal priorities.

You will work closely with the founder and operations team to translate product and business priorities into a strong online customer experience.

The ideal candidate is organized, visually minded, highly detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently inside Shopify and Klaviyo. You should be someone who notices when a product page needs attention, when a collection could be organized better, when imagery is missing, or when information on the website is outdated.

This is an in-person position based in New York.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Shopify & Website Management**

* Manage day-to-day updates to the Maure Shopify store
* Add and set up new products, including SKUs, pricing, descriptions, imagery, variants, tags, collections, and other product information
* Maintain and update existing product pages as information, inventory, imagery, or merchandising priorities change
* Build and update collections, landing pages, homepage modules, menus, and promotional placements
* Prepare products and collections for launch, ensuring all information and assets are complete and accurate before publication
* Upload, organize, crop, resize, and maintain product imagery across the website

* Merchandise products throughout the site based on seasonality, inventory, launches, best sellers, and business priorities

* Maintain accurate and consistent product information across the site
* Conduct regular website checks for outdated content, broken links, incorrect pricing, missing imagery, product errors, and other issues
* Identify opportunities to improve navigation, collection organization, product presentation, and the overall online shopping experience
* Work within the existing Shopify theme to make routine content and merchandising updates
* Coordinate with the team when technical or development support is required

**Product Launches & Digital Merchandising**

* Manage the e-commerce setup for new product launches from initial product information through publication
* Gather and organize product details, pricing, photography, descriptions, measurements, and supporting assets
* Ensure new products are correctly categorized and integrated into relevant collections and navigation
* Determine where new and priority products should appear throughout the site
* Update homepage, collection pages, gift guides, and other website areas to support launches and seasonal priorities
* Identify missing product content or imagery and coordinate or create what is needed
* Maintain a consistent standard for how products are presented across the website
* Proactively identify products or areas of the website that need attention

**Klaviyo Email**

* Build and send approximately two Klaviyo campaigns per week
* Create email layouts using existing brand guidelines, photography, product imagery, and creative assets
* Write and edit straightforward promotional and product-focused email copy
* Select products and imagery based on launches, inventory, seasonality, and merchandising priorities
* Prepare and resize imagery as needed for email
* Build, proofread, test, and QA campaigns before sending
* Maintain the email calendar and schedule campaigns
* Coordinate email timing with website updates, product launches, promotions, holidays, and seasonal moments
* Review basic campaign performance, including opens, clicks, and sales
* Use previous campaign performance to help improve future emails
* Maintain and update existing Klaviyo templates as needed

**Website Creative & Asset Production**

* Create and adapt digital assets specifically for use across the Maure website and email
* Update homepage banners, collection imagery, product compositions, promotional graphics, gift guides, and other e-commerce creative
* Retouch, crop, resize, and adapt existing product photography
* Create assets in the appropriate dimensions and formats for Shopify and Klaviyo
* Work efficiently with existing photography and brand assets to create new digital materials
* Maintain an organized library of product photography and digital assets
* Identify when additional product imagery or creative assets are needed
* Help maintain a consistent visual presentation across the website and email

The creative component of this position exists primarily to support **e-commerce merchandisin

jobs.title: Health Navigator/ Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Paid time off
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule

***For 40 years, Haitian Centers Council (HCC) has served as a trusted community resource for underserved and vulnerable populations, including immigrants, seniors, and low-income individuals. HCC provides free educational programs, healthcare linkages, prevention services, and social support to the Caribbean community regardless of economic status. Guided by the needs and voices of those it serves, HCC has spent four decades fostering a stronger, more resilient community by promoting equity, addressing health and racial disparities, and collaborating with community partners. At its core, HCC believes that wellness begins with self-care and the creation of safe, inclusive environments where everyone can thrive.***  
  
**Program Overview**

The Young Men Who Have Sex with Men (YMSM) Program provides comprehensive, community-based HIV prevention, sexual health education, and navigation services for young men who have sex with men. The program utilizes evidence based, harm reduction, and culturally responsive strategies to reduce HIV and HCV transmission, increase access to biomedical prevention, and address barriers to care.

**Purpose of the Position**

The Health Navigator / Outreach Worker is responsible for engaging YMSM through targeted outreach, delivering rapid testing services, facilitating group-level interventions, supporting drop-in programming, and providing navigation and linkage to HIV prevention and care services. This role ensures participants have access to prevention resources, supportive services, and a welcoming, affirming space.

*Key Responsibilities*

**Outreach & Community Engagement**

* Conduct community outreach a minimum of three (3) times per week, specifically targeting YMSM, in physical and virtual spaces.

* Identify and prioritize outreach efforts in areas with high HIV infection rates using local NYS ETE dashboard data.

* Provide culturally affirming education on HIV, HCV, STI prevention, sexual health, and risk-reduction strategies.

* Work at least one (1) Saturday per month and one (1) evening per month to support outreach or agency-wide programming.

  

**Testing & Screening Services**

* Provide rapid HIV and Hepatitis C (HCV) testing in community-based, wellness center, and mobile health unit settings.

* Conduct pre- and post-test counseling per NYSDOH and agency protocols.

* Ensure informed consent, confidentiality, and accurate documentation.

  
**Navigation, Referrals & Linkage to Care**  

* Provide health navigation to support access to PrEP, PEP, STI testing, HIV/HCV medical care, and supportive services.

* Address barriers such as insurance, transportation, and system navigation.

* Facilitate warm handoffs and follow-up.

  

**Group-Level Interventions & Education**

* Co-facilitate evidence-based intervention such as, Popular Opinion Leader.

* Support recruitment and engagement for group activities and workshops.

  

**Drop-In Activities & Wellness Center Support**

* Support and facilitate drop-in activities designed to promote engagement, retention, and community building among YMSM.

* Provide informal education, resource navigation, and referrals during drop-in hours.

* Ensure the wellness center is stocked and organized with essential materials, including but not limited to:

* MetroCards and transportation assistance

* Snacks and beverages

* Hygiene kits and safer sex supplies

* Educational and outreach materials

* Monitor inventory levels and communicate restocking needs to supervisors.

* Maintain a welcoming, affirming, and safe environment during all drop-in programming.

  

**Data Entry, Documentation & Quality Assurance**

* Enter all outreach, testing, navigation, and drop-in service data by the end of each business week.

* Perform self-audits of testing forms and service documentation.

* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA, NYSDOH, and agency policies.

  

**Training & Professional Development**

* Attend a minimum of twelve (12) trainings per contract year.

* Participate in supervision, staff meetings, and professional development.

It also means getting out from behind the computer. You'll sit in on client and partner meetings and help on set at FMP shoots. For Vertra, you'll restock machines, make inventory runs, and help run building events.

What you'll do

Who you are

* A true generalist, as comfortable in a client meeting as on a shoot or in a stockroom
* A strong multitasker who can switch between two companies and very different tasks in the same day
* Proactive: you spot what needs doing and handle it before you're asked
* Organized and detail-minded, with follow-through people can count on
* A clear, professional communicator in writing and in person
* Discreet with confidential business information
* Calm and flexible when shoots run long, machines break, or priorities shift
* Happy to do whatever the day needs; no task is beneath you

Requirements

* 5+ years as an executive assistant, operations coordinator, production coordinator, or in a similar fast-paced role
* A valid driver's license, a reliable vehicle, and a clean driving record (mileage reimbursed at the IRS rate)

* Able to work in person across northern New Jersey

Nice to have

* Experience in vending, retail, route sales, or inventory management
* Familiarity with Dropbox, Canva, a CRM, or QuickBooks
* Comfort using AI tools to work faster

Schedule, location, and pay

* **Pay:** $35 per hour, based on experience
* **Schedule:** Part-time to start, about 20–30 hours a week, with a path to full-time. Mostly weekdays, with occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekends.
* **Location:** In person across northern New Jersey (meetings, shoots, and Vertra sites), with some admin work from home
* **Benefits:** Mileage reimbursement, paid sick leave, and room to grow into a full-time role

Email your resume to Jason@fmpcreations.com and a short note to with the subject line **"Executive Assistant – [Your Name]"**.

jobs.title: Media Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Pretzl**

Transforming B2B Marketing, One Buyer Journey at a Time

Pretzl is redefining what a B2B marketing agency can be. As a B2B Technology-and-People-as-a-

Service (TaPaaS) agency with approx. 350 people globally, we're not just advising clients - we're

building the technology that transforms how businesses connect with their buyers.

As part of our expansion, our media team in the US is growing fast and we need super stars to

help us grow and deliver great media plans, and best-in-class service for our clients

**Role:**

The Media Account Manager plays a central role in turning client objectives into effective paid

media campaigns and ensuring those campaigns are delivered successfully from brief through

to reporting and optimization.

You will support the day-to-day of client relationships and media activity, working with the

wider team to meet client marketing and business objectives - translating these into clear media

recommendations and direction for the activation teams.

This is both a client-facing and hands-on media role. You’ll be expected to understand the detail

of the campaigns you manage (direct buys) while also seeing the bigger picture, helping to

coordinate activity being managed by our activation teams. You’ll have the opportunity to

interrogate briefs, identify opportunities to improve performance, and ultimately help clients

make better marketing decisions.

You’ll also play an important role in developing more junior members of the team and creating a

collaborative, proactive account culture.

**Skills:**

You’ll ideally bring:

* Strong knowledge of paid media and an understanding of how different channels can

work together within an integrated media plan.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into insights and actionable

recommendations.

* The ability to understand a client's marketing objectives and connect media

recommendations and performance back to their wider business goals.

* Confidence managing day-to-day client communications
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present

recommendations clearly and credibly.

* Excellent organization and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate

multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines.

* A proactive, solution-oriented approach to campaign challenges and client needs.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial considerations involved in

managing media accounts.

* Strong attention to detail while maintaining sight of broader client objectives.
* Curiosity about the changing media and B2B marketing landscape and an interest in

bringing new ideas to clients.

* The confidence to constructively challenge a brief or existing approach when there is a

better solution.

* A collaborative style and the ability to support and develop junior colleagues (Account

Executives and Senior Account Executives).

* Adaptability, initiative and the ability to make sound decisions in a fast-moving

environment.

**Responsibilities:**

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

* Acting as a key day-to-day contact for clients and building trusted relationships through

responsive, knowledgeable and proactive account management.

* Developing a strong understanding of clients' businesses, audiences, products,

competitors and marketing objectives.

* Interrogating client briefs, asking the right questions and helping translate business and

marketing objectives into effective media recommendations.

* Leading the development of multi-channel media plans, working with specialist teams

and senior colleagues where appropriate.

* Evaluating media opportunities and recommending the channels, partners, audiences

and approaches most appropriate to the brief.

* Clearly communicating media recommendations and the rationale behind them to

clients and internal stakeholders.

* Coordinating campaign activation across internal teams, clients, media partners and

other stakeholders to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time.

* Maintaining a clear view of campaign delivery, budget and performance and proactively

addressing issues before they affect client outcomes.

* Identifying and driving optimization opportunities based on campaign data, audience

insights and wider client objectives.

* Ensuring reporting goes beyond campaign metrics to explain what performance means,

what has been learned and what action should be taken next.

* Contributing insight and recommendations to client reviews, QBRs and wider strategic

conversations.

* Working with analytics and technology teams to resolve reporting challenges and

improve the quality and usefulness of campaign measurement.

* Managing the day-to-day financial processes for assigned accounts, including budgets,

forecasts, bookings and billing, in partnership with the wider team.

* Managing client and media partner expectations and handling day-to-day issues

confidently, escalating appropriately when needed.

* Delegating effectively to Account Executives and other junior team members, helping

them prioritize their work and supporting their development.

**Benefits:**

* 20 paid vacation days per year, increasing to 25 days after 1 year's service
* X3 Float Days per year to celebrate moments that matter
* x2 Volunteer Time Off days a year
* 11 paid holidays per year
* 10 paid sick days per year
* Time off to vote
* Flexible working
* Flexible medical, dental and vision coverage
* Modern Health mental health and emotional wellness support
* Carrot fertility services
* 401(K) retirement plan administered through Fidelity
* Pet Discount Program: Nationwide offers a voluntary employee-paid pet insurance benefit covering various types of pets

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
  
  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution.
  
  
More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT and many more.
  
  
Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.
  
  
The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!  
  
About the team  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital advertising solutions with the goal of helping consumers find and discover products and services. We help advertisers reach global audiences via Amazon owned and operated sites (Amazon.com, IMDb.com), millions of Fire TVs, Kindles, and Fire Tablets, and on high-quality sites across the internet via the Amazon DSP. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, our advertising solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and solidify brand loyalty. If you are interested in joining a world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  
  
Amazon Adapt is a program designed to offer coverage solutions for business gaps which may occur due to extended leave (parental, medical) and unexpected account transitions. Amazon Adapt deploys highly skilled, hyper-agile talent that ensures customers can continue to invest in their partnerships with Amazon Advertising, uninterrupted. The program ensures that the high bar for customer service, strategic partnership, and revenue attainment is maintained during these coverage gaps.  
  
As a member of the Amazon Adapt team, you will have the opportunity to complete a series of rotations across a range of consumer industries. This enables Adapt team members to experience high-velocity exposure to teams across the organization and to clients across different verticals. From day 1 Adapt team members must use their experience to earn trust with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of account relationships within a team. As a member of the Adapt team you will use your experience and vast knowledge to drive results for advertisers and internal stakeholders. Adapt team members are decisive, knowledgeable, and use high judgement. The Adapt role will give you a chance to Learn and be Curious and the autonomy to own projects that will help you advance your career at Amazon. The Adapt team prioritizes flexibility, and hires for both 40 and 30 hour work weeks.

You will independently own all client relationships, revenue targets, and product selling. For endemic accounts, you will manage the full product suite across SPB, Display, and Video. For non-endemic accounts, you will manage DSP renewals, audience strategy, and multi-tactic adoption across Performance+, Brand+, and 3P Deals. * Manage full-funnel selling: SPB + Display + Video (endemic) or DSP + P+ + B+ + 3P Deals (non-endemic)
* Own Salesforce pipeline end-to-end including DAA renewals and forecasting
* Deliver 100% pitch coverage and 90%+ renewal rates
* Maintain zero dark periods greater than 60 days
* Conduct quarterly sprint themes from Core4 diagnostic (endemic) or quarterly performance reviews (non-endemic)
* Present QBRs, campaign performance reviews, and proposals to clients
* Identify and execute upsell/cross-sell opportunities across the full product suite
* Manage all sales calls, proposals, and stakeholder relationships independently

As a Full Funnel Seller on the Adapt team, you start your day with a pipeline review in Salesforce, checking renewal timelines, campaign pacing, and upcoming pitch deadlines across your accounts. After lunch, you conduct a campaign optimization review, identify upsell opportunities, and draft a proposal. You close out the day updating Salesforce, managing stakeholder follow-ups, and planning tomorrow's client meetings. You own the entire commercial relationship for your accounts.

The Amazon Adapt team specializes in dynamic work. Our team supports the Global Amazon Ads Organization during gaps in business coverage due to leaves of absence, roles to be hired, and unexpected employee movement. Amazon Adapt's vision is to provide the world's most customer-centric business coverage, exceeding both customer and employee expectations during periods of transition.  
  
This role provides rotational coverage for single-seller accounts where you own the advertiser relationship. When a single seller goes on LOA or there is a TBH, Adapt is the only solution to maintain account relationships and protect revenue. You will operate as the sole point of contact across the full product suite. The Adapt team prioritizes flexibility and hires for both 40 and 30 hour work weeks.

jobs.title: Community Manager

This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn an idea into a post, keep a content calendar moving, and make our channels feel active and worth following. You'll create and publish content, respond to our audience, and use performance data and community feedback to improve what we put out. Social media management is the primary focus, with community engagement woven into the daily work.

This role is based full-time in our New York City office.

**You will:**

* Own the social content calendar and day-to-day publishing across channels such as Instagram, TikTok, and X, adapting the format, copy, and timing to each platform
* Create and edit social content, including short-form videos, captions, stories, memes, and simple graphics; work with designers and video editors when additional production support is needed

* Track reach, engagement, shares, saves, video watch time, audience growth, and referral traffic; report on what is working and test new formats, hooks, and posting times
* Monitor community sentiment and recurring feedback, share useful insights with the team, and flag sensitive issues promptly; follow internal moderation and content approval guidelines

* Experience managing social media accounts for a brand, startup, creator, or community, with examples of content you created and results you helped drive
* Strong writing and editing skills, a feel for internet culture, and the ability to adapt a brand's voice across posts, comments, and direct messages
* Comfortable shooting and editing short-form video and making simple social assets with tools such as CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite
* Organized and responsive, with the judgment to manage a publishing calendar, prioritize community replies, and use platform analytics to improve content
* Familiarity with poker, gaming, sports, or consumer apps is a plus; comfortable learning the product and explaining it clearly to new and existing users
* Must be able to work on-site in our New York City office

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Free Equinox membership for the in-person team
* Dinner provided in the office every night

**Company Overview**

Caliber Car Wash was founded in 2018 in Atlanta, GA. The goal of the founders was to build a “best in class” car wash company with a focus on improving the customer experience. Today, the company operates with 64 locations throughout the southeast US and Texas. The company has a projected growth to 100+ Stores in the next 3 years! Caliber is dedicated to the communities they serve through superior customer service. If you are a solutions-oriented, proactive, service industry leader, seeking an opportunity with a growing organization that cares about its people; we need to talk!

**Our Purpose**

Caliber exists to *Improve People’s Lives* by providing career opportunities and professional growth to our team members and by providing exceptional service worth our customer’s loyalty.

**Role Summary**

The Field Marketing Specialist is an on-site marketing generalist who keeps marketing running at store level and in the field: coordination, organic social, signage and in-store execution, and local store marketing. Reports to the VP, Marketing; executes on the ground while Creative, CRM, and paid own their lanes. Works in person at Atlanta-area stores and digitally supports and coordinates activations for all Caliber locations.

This role exists to make marketing easier for the field, not to add to its workload. Success means district and site managers trust marketing, call marketing when something happens, and see results at their stores. The ideal candidate has experience running grassroots and local store marketing for a multi-unit retail or service brand; is hands-on, detail-oriented, and operator-minded; and expects to spend real time in the field working with field operations teams.

Car wash may not be the first industry that comes to mind for a marketing career, and that is exactly the opportunity. Express car wash is a fast-growing, membership-driven business built on the same subscription model that powers streaming, software, and fitness brands. In this role, you’ll see firsthand

how recurring revenue works: acquiring members, converting single-wash customers, and reducing churn, all measured store by store. Few early-career roles combine hands-on local marketing with subscription business experience, and both skill sets carry into any industry you choose next.

**Responsibilities**

The essential functions of this role include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Drive local store marketing and grassroots activation that lifts store traffic.

Leverage a trade-area profile for each store (schools, employers, apartments, competitors, events) and turn it into activity: fundraisers with schools, teams, and nonprofits; affinity program activations; business, apartment, and other local partnerships; and community events. Work from a ready-to-use play menu designed around the situational needs of individual car wash locations. Diagnose before prescribing, prioritize stores by need rather than spreading effort evenly, and measure through predetermined KPIs and store-level lift.

* Own store-level marketing execution across signage, merchandising, and promotions.

Coordinate signage needs from a catalog; manage promo swaps, new-store and refresh rollouts, POS screen content, digital menus / reader boards, in-store merchandising, and store audits to ensure campaigns are live and accurate.

* Creatively produce organic social and community content as needed.
* Coordinate field marketing requests and cross-functional follow-through.

Serve as the marketing intake point for district and site managers. Turn field signals into action and close the loop on every request. Coordinate with Creative, CRM, paid media, Ops, IT, vendors, and webstore partners.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Degree not required, but a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, public relations, business, or a related field is preferred. In its place, relevant experience, creativity, and curiosity carry equal weight.
* 1–3 years of field, local, retail, or multi-unit marketing experience is a plus.
* Experience in a multi-unit, high-growth environment preferred. Car wash, QSR, or retail operations experience is a bonus.
* **Creative and curious:** brings fresh ideas and is eager to learn what works at each site and why.
* **Operator-minded:** understands, or is eager to learn, what moves a site (cars per day, membership conversion, churn, weather, staffing) and how much a marketing ask means to a busy site team.
* **Field partnership:** builds trust with district and site managers; translates needs into action and prioritizes well.
* **Generalist range & organization:** owns many small tasks without dropping details; manages multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* **Eye for design:** knows what looks right and on-brand, from signage and merchandising to social content and creative direction, and spots what’s offat a site and gets it fixed.
* **AI-assisted:** uses AI tools where appropriate to move faster (project management, admin, first drafts, and creative brainstorming, but never the final product).
* **Effective communicator:** collaborates across all levels of the organization; is proactive and comfortable sharing opinions in group settings.
* **Understands concept-to-impact:** takes an idea from first concept through execution to measurable results, and can point to activations, events, or programs they’ve led in any educational, community, or business setting.

**Tools & Metrics**

* **Tools & systems**: Microsoft Office Suite, Claude, Canva, organic social schedulers, Google Business Profile / Yext listings, and a project tracker. Car wash-specific systems include Rinsed (CRM), DRB and Sonny’s (POS), and digital menu boards; no prior experience is expected, and training is provided.

Crabapple Martial Arts Academy is a family-focused martial arts school in Milton, GA (the Crabapple / Alpharetta area). We teach children and families focus, confidence, discipline, and respect — skills that show up in the classroom, at home, and for life. We're the flagship school of a growing martial-arts company, so there's real room to grow with us.

**The opportunity**

We're hiring a Sales and Enrollment Representative to be the person who brings new families through our doors. You'll start by getting our name into the community and booking families for their first lesson. As you prove yourself, you'll grow into closing new enrollments and selling our long-term programs — with your pay growing at every step. This is for someone who loves people, loves to win, and wants their income to reflect their results.

**What you'll do**

* Build interest in the community through school events, local partnerships, and referral events

This role is built in stages. You start by filling our pipeline and booking appointments. Once you do that consistently, we add enrollment and commission on every family you sign. Once you've proven that, we add our long-term program sales — the highest-earning part of the job. Each stage adds responsibility and pay.

* 2+ years in a goal-driven, customer-facing role (sales, membership or enrollment sales, business development, recruiting, real estate, hospitality, or similar)

**Founding Sales Growth Advisor – Software (Remote)**

$20k – $100k

Founding Sales Growth Advisor – Software (Remote)

Help Build the Future of Business Technology

Arriv Global is building an interconnected ecosystem of business technology designed to help organizations communicate, sell, recruit, hire, train, manage teams, and grow more efficiently.

We're looking for ambitious, relationship-driven individuals to join our founding software sales team and help introduce businesses to the growing Arriv ecosystem.

If you enjoy building relationships, learning technology, solving business problems, and creating opportunities, we'd love to meet you.

Why Join Arriv?

This isn't just another software sales position.

You'll be joining an early-stage technology company where you'll work closely with the founder and help shape how our sales organization grows.

Our founding Sales Growth Advisors aren't simply stepping into an established sales department and following an old playbook.

You'll help build the playbook.

As Arriv expands its technology, customer base, and markets, our founding sales team will help influence future sales strategies, processes, territory development, and growth initiatives.

If you've ever wanted the opportunity to help build a technology company from the ground up, this is your opportunity.

What You'll Represent

Sales Growth Advisors may introduce businesses to authorized solutions within the growing Arriv ecosystem, including:

Arriv One – AI-powered business communication, sales, CRM, calling, messaging, and workflow technology

Khetha IQ – recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and workforce technology

Arriv Payroll – payroll and compensation solutions designed to integrate with business operations

Additional Arriv products and services as the ecosystem continues to expand

Rather than selling disconnected software products, you'll help businesses understand how different parts of the Arriv ecosystem can work together to solve real operational challenges.

What You'll Do

As an Arriv Sales Growth Advisor, you'll:

Build relationships with business owners, executives, managers, and decision-makers.

Introduce organizations to Arriv's software and technology solutions.

Conduct discovery conversations to understand how businesses currently operate.

Identify problems, inefficiencies, and opportunities where Arriv technology may help.

Recommend appropriate Arriv solutions based on each organization's actual needs.

Conduct virtual product conversations, demonstrations, and presentations.

Generate new business through networking, referrals, phone calls, email, social outreach, and approved local outreach.

Build and manage your own sales pipeline.

Follow up with prospective customers throughout the sales process.

Develop long-term relationships with the accounts you originate.

Maintain accurate sales and customer activity records.

Represent Arriv professionally within your assigned market.

Collaborate directly with leadership as Arriv's products and sales organization continue to evolve.

Our approach is discovery first.

We don't want Sales Growth Advisors pushing the largest package possible.

We want you to understand the customer's problem and recommend the Arriv solution that makes sense for their business.

Who We're Looking For

This opportunity may be a great fit for someone who:

✔ Enjoys talking with people

✔ Loves building professional relationships

✔ Is curious about technology

✔ Is comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers

✔ Is self-motivated

✔ Has an entrepreneurial mindset

✔ Enjoys solving problems

✔ Can manage their own pipeline and follow-up

✔ Is comfortable creating new opportunities

✔ Wants to grow alongside an early-stage technology company

✔ Is coachable, motivated, and willing to learn

Previous experience in B2B sales, SaaS, technology, business development, recruiting, payroll, HR technology, or other customer-facing roles is helpful, but not required.

You don't need to arrive knowing every Arriv product.

We'll teach you the technology, the sales process, and how the different parts of the ecosystem work together.

Compensation

This is a commission-based sales opportunity with uncapped earning potential.

Compensation may include:

Implementation/setup commissions on qualifying new customer accounts

Recurring commissions from eligible customer accounts

Performance accelerators

Additional sales incentives

There is no cap on commissions.

Because eligible accounts can generate recurring revenue, successful Sales Growth Advisors have the opportunity to build a growing portfolio of customer relationships rather than relying exclusively on one-time commissions.

Complete commission structures, eligibility requirements, and available accelerators are reviewed during the interview and onboarding process.

Estimated annual earnings: $20,000–$100,000+

Actual earnings depend on individual sales performance and are not guaranteed.

Why Sell Arriv?

Businesses increasingly rely on multiple platforms to manage communication, sales, recruiting, hiring, training, payroll, customer relationships, and internal operations.

Arriv is building technology designed to bring more of those functions into a connected ecosystem.

That gives our Sales Growth Advisors an opportunity to do more than simply sell software.

You'll learn how a business operates, identify where problems exist, and help determine where Arriv technology can provide value.

And because Arriv is still growing, you'll have the opportunity to introduce new products and capabilities to the relationships you build as the ecosystem expands.

Training & Support

Every Sales Growth Advisor receives:

Comprehensive onboarding

Sales training

Product and platform education

Software demonstration training

Prospecting and discovery training

Ongoing coaching

Sales resources

Marketing resources

Technology training

Founder support

We'll train

jobs.title: Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator

**PROVENANCE by Diana Michelle**  
900 North Michigan Shops | Chicago, IL  
**Part-Time | Approximately 15–25 hours per week**  
**Compensation: $24–$28 per hour, based on experience**

About PROVENANCE

PROVENANCE by Diana Michelle is an independent luxury boutique located at 900 North Michigan Shops in Chicago. We specialize in niche luxury fragrance, custom clothing, cashmere, jewelry and accessories, with an emphasis on exceptional product curation, personalized service, and long-term client relationships.

We are seeking a highly organized, trustworthy, and detail-oriented **Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator** to oversee the movement and documentation of merchandise from receipt through delivery to our boutique.

This is an operational role requiring a high degree of accuracy, discretion, personal accountability, and comfort working with valuable merchandise.

The Role

The Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator will help manage the merchandise flow between our vendors, receiving location, inventory system, and retail boutique.

You will be responsible for ensuring that incoming merchandise is properly received, counted, inspected, documented, entered into our inventory system when authorized, organized, and transferred to the store with a clear chain of custody.

Because this position involves access to valuable merchandise and confidential business information, **integrity, discretion, and adherence to security procedures are essential.**

Key ResponsibilitiesInventory Receiving & Verification

* Receive domestic and international merchandise shipments.
* Carefully open, inspect, and count incoming merchandise.
* Match merchandise against packing slips, invoices, purchase orders, and other receiving documentation.
* Verify quantities, SKUs, product descriptions, and other identifying information.
* Identify shortages, overages, incorrect merchandise, damaged goods, or other discrepancies.
* Photograph and document shipments or discrepancies when appropriate.
* Promptly report receiving issues to management rather than making unauthorized corrections or assumptions.

Lightspeed & Inventory Records

* Receive approved merchandise into the Lightspeed POS/inventory system.
* Accurately enter and verify quantities and product information.
* Maintain clean and accurate inventory records.
* Assist with inventory counts and reconciliation.
* Help identify discrepancies between physical merchandise and system inventory.
* Maintain accurate documentation of merchandise transfers and adjustments.
* Follow established authorization procedures for inventory changes.

System access will be limited to the functions necessary for the position. This role does not require unrestricted access to customer information, financial reporting, or other sensitive areas of the business.

Inventory Organization & Logistics

* Maintain an organized and secure receiving area.
* Sort and prepare merchandise for transfer to the PROVENANCE boutique.
* Label and organize merchandise according to established procedures.
* Coordinate the movement of inventory between the receiving location and store.
* Maintain clear documentation and chain of custody for merchandise movements.
* Confirm that merchandise leaving one location is accurately accounted for upon arrival at the other.
* Assist with vendor returns, damaged merchandise, shipment exceptions, and other inventory-related logistics.
* Keep receiving and storage areas orderly, professional, and secure.

Inventory Accuracy & Loss Prevention

* Follow established procedures for handling high-value merchandise.
* Maintain accurate counts throughout the receiving and transfer process.
* Document inventory movement rather than relying on memory or informal communication.
* Immediately escalate missing merchandise, unexplained discrepancies, damaged shipments, or unusual circumstances.
* Follow PROVENANCE security, access-control, and loss-prevention procedures at all times.

Confidentiality & Professional Standards

This position may provide access to confidential business information, including inventory levels, vendor information, purchasing records, product costs, receiving documentation, and internal operating procedures.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working within strict confidentiality and access-control guidelines.

Company information may not be copied, exported, photographed, stored on personal devices, forwarded to personal accounts, or shared with unauthorized individuals.

We believe access should be based on what is necessary to perform the job. The Inventory & Logistics Coordinator will therefore receive the system and physical access required for the position without unnecessary access to unrelated confidential business information.

Who We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who is:

* Exceptionally detail-oriented and accurate.
* Reliable and consistent.
* Highly organized.
* Trustworthy and discreet.
* Comfortable being accountable for valuable merchandise.
* Able to work independently without sacrificing accuracy.
* Methodical about documentation and process.
* Comfortable following security and access-control procedures.
* Able to identify discrepancies and escalate them appropriately.
* Professional in handling confidential business information.
* Comfortable learning inventory and POS technology.
* Someone who takes pride in leaving systems, merchandise, and workspaces organized.

You should naturally be the kind of person who notices when **12 units arrived but the paperwork says 13**—and who stops to investigate rather than simply entering the number into the system.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is helpful:

* Luxury retail
* Inventory management
* Merchandise receiving
* Stockroom or back-of-house operations
* Retail operations
* Showroom operations
* Logistics or fulfillment
* POS or inventory-management systems
* High-va

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Event Coordinator**  
**Gatherline Events · Chicago, IL · Hybrid with on-site event work**  
**$27–$30 per hour · Full-time, W-2**

Gatherline Events organizes conferences, team meetings, and client events for businesses and nonprofit organizations.

We’re looking for an Event Coordinator to help turn approved plans into well-organized events. You’ll work with an Event Producer, supporting registration, supplier coordination, schedules, and on-site delivery. You won’t be expected to lead complex events independently from day one.

**What you’ll do**

* Maintain event schedules, task lists, guest records, and planning documents.
* Request supplier quotes and confirm arrangements for catering, audiovisual equipment, signage, and transportation.
* Prepare attendee communications, joining instructions, name badges, and registration materials.
* Track confirmations, deadlines, and approved costs, raising missing information or changes promptly.
* Support events on-site by coordinating check-in, briefing suppliers, and helping guests find the right information.
* Collect feedback and organize receipts, invoices, and outstanding items after each event.

The Event Producer owns the overall budget, client commitments, and major supplier decisions. You’ll receive clear approval limits and a named escalation contact.

**What you’ll bring**

* Around one to two years of experience in events, hospitality, administration, or another role involving bookings and customer coordination.
* Strong organization and accuracy when handling names, dates, quantities, and instructions.
* Clear communication with guests, colleagues, and suppliers.
* Confidence using spreadsheets, shared calendars, and presentation tools.
* The ability to stay composed when plans change and ask for support when needed.

Relevant internships, volunteer event work, and community projects count toward experience. A college degree and event-management certification are not required. Familiarity with registration platforms is helpful; training is provided.

**Schedule, location, and travel**

During planning weeks, expect approximately **40 working hours**, usually Monday–Friday during Central Time business hours. The normal arrangement is three days in our Chicago office and two days remote.

Event assignments replace the usual office schedule and can include early starts, evenings, or weekends. Expect approximately **one or two evening or weekend assignments per month**, with busier periods communicated through the event calendar.

Event weeks may reach **45–50 hours**. All working hours are recorded, and hours worked above 40 in a workweek are paid at 1.5 times your regular rate. Meal breaks are separate from working hours.

Most events are in Greater Chicago. Expect up to four domestic trips annually, usually lasting two to three nights. Approved transportation, accommodation, and meals are covered, and required business travel time is paid under our company policy.

On-site work includes extended periods of standing and walking and handling light event materials. Reasonable accommodations are available.

**Pay and benefits**

* **$27–$30 per hour**, based on relevant coordination and event experience.
* Approximately **$56,160–$62,400 annually** at 2,080 paid hours, excluding overtime. No commission.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer contributions.
* 401(k) with an employer match.
* 15 paid vacation days, paid company holidays, and separate sick leave.
* Company laptop, required software, and paid onboarding.
* Support for approved event-industry training and professional development.

You’ll initially support smaller meetings and accompany an experienced colleague on-site before taking ownership of more complex assignments.

**How to apply**

Submit your résumé and a brief example of an event, booking, or project you helped organize. Explain your contribution; a formal portfolio is not required.

Our process includes an introductory call and a conversation with the hiring manager about a sample event scenario. There is no take-home assignment.

Candidates must be able to commute to Chicago, meet the event and travel requirements, and be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available. Interview accommodations are available upon request.

Pay: $27.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60618

jobs.title: Marketing Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Built on service. Powered by people.**
========================================

Impact exists because a small group of industry leaders believed companies in our space were doing it wrong. Many prioritized margins while the people doing the work and the clients relying on it became an afterthought. Impact was built differently: invest in great people, trust them to do great work, and deliver the kind of service clients remember. That approach helped us grow from a small office technology company into a national managed services provider, while remaining privately owned and people-first.

What makes Impact special is that growth has never come at the expense of the values that got us here. We continue to reinvest in our people, our capabilities, and the opportunities ahead so employees can grow alongside the business. We’ve built something special, but we’re far from finished. The people who join Impact now will help define what comes next.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are looking for a Marketing Manager who owns client relationships — not just manages them. Accountable for the full client experience from Executive Marketing Consultant handoff through renewal, the Marketing Manager serves as a fractional marketing director for a portfolio of 8-10 B2B clients. You translate each client’s business case into 90-day execution plans, lead Quarterly Business Reviews and Campaign Planning Reviews, direct cross-functional delivery across Strategy, Creative, Paid Media, and Web, and own the renewal conversation. Success in this role is defined by one thing: your clients’ businesses grow, and they renew because of it. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the primary client relationship from Executive Marketing Consultant handoff through renewal and expansion as the client’s single point of strategic accountability at IMM.
* Own the client business case as the single source of truth and continuously pressure-test it against evolving client objectives and market conditions.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and Campaign Planning Reviews by building the narrative, running the meeting, and following through on every commitment.
* Translate annual strategy into 90-day, hypothesis-driven execution plans tied to client business outcomes.
* Direct cross-functional delivery across Strategy, Creative, Paid Media, and Web for assigned accounts, aligning the team around the business case rather than only the task list.
* Manage the account handoff process by reviewing the full brief, flagging gaps, signing off in writing, and booking the first client check-in within 5 business days.
* Proactively monitor retention risk, account health, and expansion potential, surfacing threats and opportunities before they require escalation.
* Identify and present upsell and cross-sell opportunities to clients, with expansion MRR tracked and reviewed quarterly.
* Own the renewal conversation with support from the Head of Delivery on at-risk accounts.
* Maintain IMM Elevate records, including brief submissions, account intelligence, performance data, and renewal documentation.
* Write and execute an annual Business Plan covering role north star, value creation targets, strategic exclusions, and personal operating system.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* 3-5 years of account management, client services, or marketing management experience at an agency or B2B marketing services firm.
* Proven ownership of client business reviews, including building the narrative, running the meeting, and handling hard conversations when results are off.
* B2B marketing fluency with an understanding of how marketing connects to pipeline, revenue, and business outcomes.
* Performance marketing literacy with the ability to hold paid media, SEO, and content specialists accountable and tell a data-backed performance story to client executives.
* Active AI workflow adoption, with current hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day work.
* Cross-functional delivery experience managing output across creative, strategy, and digital teams under real deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to identify retention risk early and address it before it becomes a client-facing problem.
* Track record of growing accounts through upsell, expansion, or NRR improvement, not just renewing them flat.
* Executive communication skills with the confidence to challenge clients with perceptiveness and business acumen.
* Disciplined operating rhythm, including timely QBRs, current Elevate records, and an active business plan.

**What Drives Impact**
----------------------

Behaviors define what our core values look like in action. Leaders are expected to model them; teams are expected to live them:

* Innovation: We embrace change because innovation lives outside the comfort zone.
* Passion: We are driven by purpose, fueled by passion, and obsessed with making an impact.
* Honesty: We are fiercely transparent and consistently honest.
* Fun: We fuel work with fun, knowing life's too short for boring.
* Low Ego: We champion ideas over titles, because brilliance knows no rank.
* One Team: We win as a team, we lose as a team, we are one team.

**Compensation**
----------------

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skillset, experience and training, licensures and/or certifications, and other organizational needs.

Impact may offer applicable incentive compensation plans depending on role and/or department.

Full compensation details can and will be discussed with an Impact Talent Acquisition team member at the start of the interview process.

**Benefits We Take Pride In**
-----------------------------

* 5-year Tiffany & Co. Gift Card or Custom Menswear, 10-year Custom Rolex, 20-year $20,000 Check incentive rewards
* Valuable time off with up to 20 days of PTO, 7 Paid Sick Days, 12+ paid holiday
