jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Surety Account Manager III**

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients!

This hybrid position requires working 3 days a week from an Aon office.

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

Provides analytical and operational services for a portfolio of surety bond clients, with an emphasis on accuracy, client interaction, underwriting pricing rigor & negotiation, and execution quality. Partners closely with clients to facilitate timely issuance of surety obligations. Reports to the regional Surety Operations leader. (Director or Team Lead).

* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and judgment across complex or strategically significant accounts and in dealing with markets.
* Takes primary accountability for handling selected key accounts, including coordination of large bond programs and sophisticated underwriting submissions.
* Possesses strong, in-depth knowledge of surety bonds, including contract and commercial surety, indemnity structures, and market dynamics.
* Serves as a technical lead within the team; assists in training, mentoring, and developing internal team, and contributes to improvement in execution initiatives.
* Collaborates daily with carriers on complex needs. Prepares and processes a broad range of surety instruments, including but not limited to bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds, ensuring alignment with underwriting parameters and client requirements.
* Collaborates daily with clients on complex needs. Completes Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other client required obligations per State requirements. Determines appropriate documentation to finalize issuance, i.e. power-of-attorney, resident license, etc. with attention to contractual, legal, and financial implications.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications, coordinating with and advising clients to obtain complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review – including any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
* Maintains and facilitates data integrity and enabling proactive management of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).
* Works closely with internal collaborators to build and maintain accurate, complete electronic bond files in AonBondLink (ABL). It also confirms and manages client financial and underwriting records while following internal controls and audit requirements to avoid E&O.
* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety guidance and support to non-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal stakeholders.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority; assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests that exceed standard limits or fall outside delegated authority.

**How this opportunity is different**

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in operational improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Is able to effectively interpret a wide range of technical instructions and documentation involving abstract and concrete variables, including financial analyses, contractual provisions, and underwriting guidelines.
* Possesses experience or formal education in Risk Management, Insurance, and/or Surety, and applies this background to enhance client and market outcomes.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, time-management, and multi-tasking skills, consistently managing high-volume and complex workloads.
* Maintains Notary Public designation.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and is regarded as a trusted signatory.
* Maintains appropriate Producer license
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook, and utilizes these systems to manage data, analyze bond portfolios, and support decision-making.

Education and licensing requirements: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Property and Casualty license.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
  
  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution.
  
  
More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT and many more.
  
  
Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.
  
  
The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!  
  
About the team  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience with Microsoft Excel
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for two (2) of the following: compute, storage, networking, CDN, databases, DevOps, big data and analytics, security, or applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Experience designing, implementing, operating or consulting on distributed applications

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience producing executive-level written materials and presenting to executive audiences
* Do you have experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings?
* Do you have experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead?

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Social Media Manager (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Part-Time Social Media Manager

**Crepe Nation Express | Old Town, Chicago**

About Crepe Nation Express

Crepe Nation Express is a Fast-Casual Sweet & Savory Brunch Concept focused on crepes, waffles, and pancakes.

Our journey started with a restaurant over five years ago. After two years of operating our original restaurant, we stepped away from the restaurant side to focus on developing and growing our signature mixes. Today, those same mixes are used both by customers at home and in our restaurant.

Crepe Nation Express is our return to the restaurant space with a new, lightweight express model. Our first location is now open in Old Town, Chicago, and we're building the brand both inside the restaurant and throughout the local community.

Our customers are our **Citizens**, and we're looking for someone who can help bring the Crepe Nation Express experience to life online.

The Role

We're looking for a **Part-Time Social Media Manager** to take ownership of our social media presence.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be on-site creating high-quality photos and videos, planning and publishing content, keeping our channels active, engaging with our community, and finding ways to get Crepe Nation Express in front of more people in Chicago.

We're not looking for someone who simply posts when they are told to. We want someone who understands social media, pays attention to what's happening in the community, spots opportunities, creates content around them, and knows how to turn everyday moments at the restaurant into content people want to see.

You will not be required to be the face of the brand. Your job is to capture the brand, the food, the experience, and the community around it.

What You'll Do

Content Creation

* Create high-quality photos and videos of our food, restaurant, team, customers, events, and day-to-day experiences
* Develop original content ideas that fit the Crepe Nation Express brand
* Capture content on-site consistently
* Turn everyday moments at the restaurant into engaging social content
* Create content around new menu items, promotions, events, and seasonal opportunities

Social Media Management

* Maintain a consistent posting schedule across our social platforms
* Plan content ahead while remaining flexible enough to respond to trends and opportunities
* Write captions and social copy that fit our brand voice
* Keep our social channels active, current, and engaging
* Monitor comments, direct messages, tags, and mentions
* Respond to our online community and encourage meaningful interaction

Community & Local Growth

* Build relationships with local creators, influencers, foodies, businesses, and community members
* Identify local influencers and creators who align with the Crepe Nation Express brand
* Reach out to and develop collaborations with relevant local creators
* Engage with local conversations, events, trends, and communities
* Find opportunities to get Crepe Nation Express involved in the Old Town and wider Chicago community
* Help turn online engagement into visits to the restaurant

Trends & Growth

* Stay ahead of social media trends and identify opportunities relevant to the brand
* Participate in trends when they make sense for Crepe Nation Express
* Develop original trends, content concepts, and recurring series that people can associate with the brand
* Test different types of content and learn from what performs
* Monitor social media performance and use insights to improve future content

What We're Looking For

* Proven experience managing social media for a brand, business, creator, restaurant, or similar organization
* Strong photography and video skills
* A strong eye for what makes content visually appealing and engaging
* Understanding of what performs on platforms such as Instagram and TikTok
* Creative thinker who can consistently come up with new content ideas
* Strong writing and communication skills
* Comfortable working independently and taking initiative
* Strong understanding of social media trends and online communities
* Ability to work on-site at our Old Town location to create content
* Strong interest in food, hospitality, culture, and local communities

**A portfolio or examples of previous social media work are required.**

What Success Looks Like

You'll know you're doing a great job when:

* Crepe Nation Express is consistently showing up in people's feeds
* Our content looks professional, current, and unmistakably ours
* Our audience is growing and actively engaging with our content
* Local creators and influencers know who we are
* People are talking about us online without us having to ask
* Our social channels feel like an extension of the restaurant itself
* Social media is contributing to awareness, community, and visits to the restaurant

Why Join Crepe Nation Express?

* Part-time position with a growing food brand
* Creative ownership of our social media presence
* Opportunity to help shape the voice and identity of the brand
* Work directly with a growing restaurant in Old Town, Chicago
* Employee meal discounts
* Opportunity to grow with the brand

**Location:** Old Town, Chicago  
**Position:** Part-Time Social Media Manager

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a portfolio or examples of previous social media work? If yes, include it in your application.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60610

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a driven, curious, and resilient Sales Development Representative to join our Inside Sales Team. This is not a holding pattern role; it is the first chapter of a clearly defined career in sales.

As an SDR, you will be responsible for generating qualified meetings through a mix of outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification. You will work closely with your field sales counterparts to hand off those meetings, ensuring every introduction is well-briefed, timely, and set up to convert.

This role is also the foundation of your sales career. The skills, commercial instincts, and client relationships you build here are what will prepare you for promotion to Business Development Manager within 6 to 12 months, where you will own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close.

This role is built on two foundations. First, execution: showing up, doing the work, and consistently delivering output. Second, growth: developing the judgment, curiosity, and persuasion skills that turn a good SDR into a great closer.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Pipeline generation**

* Execute high-volume outbound prospecting via phone, email, and other tools to identify and engage potential clients

* Qualify inbound leads using a structured framework, assessing fit, urgency, and decision-making authority

* Book qualified meetings and hand them off to a BDM with a thorough, well-prepared brief

* Consistently meet or exceed weekly and monthly activity and meeting targets

**Client engagement**

* Research target accounts before outreach, understand their business, hiring challenges, and the commercial impact of those challenges

* Ask enough of the right questions during outreach to qualify the opportunity and set your BDM up for a strong first conversation

* Handle common objections confidently and credibly, influencing rather than scripting your way through conversations

* Follow up on the outcomes of your handoffs, stay curious about what happens after the meeting is booked and use it to sharpen your approach

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with your BDM counterparts, providing thorough meeting briefs and acting as a reliable first point of contact for new prospects

* Keep Salesforce records accurate and up to date, logging all activity and tracking pipeline stages

* Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles, rapidly applying feedback to improve your approach

* Contribute to a culture of high activity, honest feedback, and shared accountability

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

We hire for two things: the ability to execute today, and the potential to grow into a future closer. You do not need to have worked in staffing before. You do need to be the kind of person who finds a way to get things done.

**Execution — you deliver consistent output and pipeline**

Grit / Resilience

You sustain performance through rejection. A tough week doesn’t derail you — it sharpens your focus.

Activity Capacity

You are comfortable with high-volume outreach and bring structure and energy to every day.

Work Ethic / Discipline

You manage your own time, set your own targets, and don’t need close supervision to stay on track.

Coachability

You take feedback fast and apply it faster. You see coaching as a competitive advantage, not a criticism.

**Growth — you have the potential to become a future BDM**

Business Acumen

You connect hiring challenges to business impact. You ask why, not just what.

Discovery Depth

You ask the question behind the question. You don’t surface needs — you uncover them.

Ownership Mindset

You think beyond the meeting. You care about outcomes, not just activity.

Deal Curiosity

You want to know what happens after the handoff. You use those lessons to get better.

Persuasion Skills

You influence rather than script. You adapt to the person in front of you.

Internal Selling

You collaborate well. You know that winning externally starts with alignment internally.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* A genuine interest in sales and a clear desire to build a career as a closer

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, you can hold a conversation and write a compelling email

* A track record of hitting targets or goals in any context: work, academics, sport, or otherwise

* The ability to handle rejection and keep going without losing energy or professionalism

* Comfort with technology, CRM tools, LinkedIn and email sequencing platforms

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in a sales, customer-facing, or high-volume outreach role

* Exposure to the staffing, recruiting, or workforce solutions industry

* Experience using Salesforce and sales enablement platforms

* A degree in business, communications, or a related field, though we care more about drive than credentials

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

In your first 30 days, you will have completed onboarding, learned our solutions and client base, started your first outreach cadences, and booked your first qualified meetings.

By 90 days, you will be consistently hitting your meeting targets, running discovery calls with support, and actively contributing to pipeline. Your CRM will be clean, your activity levels high, and your feedback loops fast.

By 6 to 12 months, you will have demonstrated readiness to progress to Business Development Manager, running

new_jobs.title: Jewelry Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Production Coordinator is responsible for helping manage the daily flow of production from order entry through completion, quality review, and preparation for invoicing and shipment.

This position works closely with Production, Sales, Client Services, Accounting, Shipping, management, and outside vendors to ensure orders are progressing according to schedule, completed accurately, and meet MICHAEL M's quality standards.

The Production Coordinator is expected to maintain clear visibility into active orders, proactively identify delays or discrepancies, and follow through until issues are resolved.

Position Responsibilities

**Production Coordination and Order Management**

* Coordinate daily production orders and ensure orders are progressing according to schedule.
* Track production orders from start to finish and monitor expected completion and delivery dates.
* Coordinate with the production team to obtain accurate and timely updates on active orders.
* Identify orders that are delayed or at risk of missing their required delivery date and escalate concerns promptly.
* Prioritize and closely monitor rush orders, special orders, and other time-sensitive requests.
* Communicate with vendors and outside suppliers regarding materials, components, backorders, outstanding items, and rush requirements.
* Follow up consistently on outstanding production issues until they are resolved.
* Coordinate with Production, Sales, Client Services, Accounting, and Shipping to help ensure orders move efficiently through each stage of the process.

**Quality Control and Order Accuracy**

* Inspect finished merchandise for quality, workmanship, condition, and accuracy before products move to invoicing or shipment.
* Review completed merchandise against production orders, invoices, customer requirements, and applicable specifications.
* Verify item numbers, quantities, sizes, metals, materials, pricing, and other relevant order information.
* Confirm that finished merchandise matches the original order requirements and production instructions.
* Identify quality concerns, order discrepancies, missing information, or other issues before merchandise is invoiced or shipped.
* Communicate discrepancies to the appropriate department and coordinate corrections as needed.
* Assist in maintaining consistent MICHAEL M quality and accuracy standards throughout the production and fulfillment process.

**Order Processing and Documentation**

* Assist with order processing, quotes, production documentation, and other order-related requirements.
* Maintain accurate production statuses, notes, expected completion dates, and supporting information within company systems.
* Maintain organized and accurate production, quality control, and order records.
* Ensure relevant production updates and changes are communicated to the appropriate departments.
* Verify that required information and documentation are complete before orders move to the next stage.

**Production Reporting and Issue Resolution**

* Prepare weekly production reports for management.
* Maintain visibility into open orders, overdue orders, upcoming due dates, rush orders, backorders, and orders at risk of delay.
* Identify recurring production delays, bottlenecks, quality issues, or process problems and communicate them to management.
* Work with management and the appropriate departments to resolve production problems and minimize their impact on customer delivery dates.
* Assist with additional production and operational responsibilities as needed.

Core Expectations

Accuracy, attention to detail, reliability, urgency, organization, and consistent follow-through are essential requirements of this position.

The Production Coordinator is expected to take ownership of assigned orders and follow issues through resolution rather than simply reporting their status. Potential production or quality problems should be identified and communicated as early as possible so corrective action can be taken before they affect the customer.

Qualifications

* 2+ years of experience in production coordination, order management, manufacturing, quality control, operations, purchasing, or a related role preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple orders and deadlines simultaneously.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong follow-up and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to inspect products carefully and identify discrepancies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with internal departments, vendors, and suppliers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook.
* Experience with ERP, inventory, manufacturing, or order-management systems preferred.
* Jewelry, luxury goods, manufacturing, or related industry experience is a plus, but not required.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

* How many years of experience do you have in production coordination, order processing, manufacturing, quality control, inventory, or a similar operational role?

* Are you comfortable working full-time, Monday through Friday, in our Burbank office?

Ability to Commute:

* Burbank, CA 91502 (Required)

new_jobs.title: Account Manager III, Client Service Management
new_jobs.description:
The Client Service Manager role is a sales-incented, relationship-focused role responsible for helping drive growth across existing and prospective accounts. In partnership with the Account Manager, you will build relationships with Taft-Hartley trust funds, fund administrators, and other key stakeholders to understand their needs, identify opportunities, and connect them with solutions that support their goals.

Primer Concepts partners directly with well-known brands like Verizon to run in-person sales campaigns. Our team works face-to-face with customers, representing our clients with honesty. We invest real time into training every entry-level Verizon Account Manager we bring on.

new_jobs.title: Key Customer Account Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
**At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.**  
  
**As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.**

**Job Summary:**  
Manages and develops assigned key customer accounts by serving as a trusted partner and advocate. Supports account growth through proactive engagement, strategic collaboration, and sales solutions that align with customer needs. Coordinates internally to ensure accurate order fulfillment, service delivery, and issue resolution. Applies working knowledge of products and construction industry solutions to strengthen customer retention and account performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Serves as the primary liason for assigned key accounts, building and maintaining long-term customer relationships.
  
Supports account growth by identifying upselling and cross-selling expanding the network of relationships, and partnering with customers early to understand short and long-term business needs.
  
Coordinates with internal teams to support accurate procurement, delivery, service, and billing for customers.
  
Tracks and reports on account performance metrics, and identifies additional partnership opportunities.
  
Acts as a customer advocate by resolving service or delivery issues and communicating updates and recommendations.
  
Applies product knowledge and construction‑industry expertise to offer practical, innovative solutions.

Bachelor’s degree in business, construction management, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

3–5 years of experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles required.
  
2-3+ years of construction supply and rental equipment industry knowledge preferred.
  
  
**Certifications and Licenses:**  
None required.

DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek.

  
  

Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

new_jobs.description:

* Ensure all escalation responses are accurate, compliant, and aligned with organizational tone and quality expectations.

* Maintain clear, professional, and effective communication with internal stakeholders, including leadership and cross-functional partners.
* Support reporting needs related to escalation trends, risks, and service recovery outcomes.

**Compliance & Confidentiality**

* Maintain strict adherence to HIPAA, privacy, and data security standards.
* Ensure all member interactions and case documentation meet regulatory and organizational compliance requirements.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Assist with monitoring attendance and schedule adherence.
* Encourage a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Supports the Supervisor, Customer Success in the day-to-day oversight of team operations. Assists with planning and monitoring work; provides input on performance, as needed. Acts as a role model and leader within the team, particularly in handling escalations and supporting frontline staff.

* Required:
  + Strong knowledge of Medicare Managed Care plans required

  + Previous Lead or equivalent experience required
* Preferred:
  + Experience handling complex or executive-level escalations strongly preferred
  + Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred

new_jobs.title: Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts
new_jobs.description:
**Exciting opportunity to be eligible for a $5,500 bonus when you join our team.**

As a **Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts,** you will own and grow a portfolio of complex, high-growth Medium Business customers while developing new opportunities across assigned accounts. These customers are expanding, evolving, and navigating increasingly complex technology decisions, requiring a consultative seller who can build trust, uncover business needs, and position solutions that create measurable value. This is a strategic, quota-carrying outside sales role for an experienced B2B seller who can balance account maintenance, service coordination, prospecting, pipeline creation, and complex solution selling. You will work closely with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, and cross-functional teams to help customers evaluate technology choices, solve business challenges, and invest in solutions that support long-term growth. This role is designed for sellers who are technical, resourceful, disciplined, and comfortable competing in a sophisticated market where customers have more choices than ever.

**Earn with confidence and upside.** This role offers a competitive base salary as well as performance-based commission tied directly to your sales results. At 100% of target, **annual earnings range from $116,700 – $147,500.** If you are motivated by ownership, measurable goals, and the ability to increase your income through performance, this role is designed for you.

**What you’ll do**

* **Balance field and office collaboration:** When not in the field, sales employees are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location and place of work.
* **Own and grow Platinum level accounts.** Build account plans that prioritize retention, expansion, new opportunity creation, customer relationship depth, and long-term revenue growth.
* **Balance service and sales priorities.** Manage account maintenance and customer service needs while protecting time for prospecting, pipeline development, and closing new business.
* **Create and manage strategic pipelines.** Generate opportunities through account mapping, executive outreach, referrals, partner collaboration, customer expansion plays, and targeted prospecting.
* **Navigate complex technical solutions.** Learn and position wired, mobility, connectivity, and advanced technology solutions while translating technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* **Orchestrate internal and partner resources.** Collaborate with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, product specialists, and support teams to design and deliver the right customer solution.
* **Differentiate in a competitive market.** Compete against direct providers, indirect competitors, vendors, resellers, and internal channel overlap by selling value, relationship, expertise, and business impact.
* **Lead a consultative sales process.** Diagnosing customer needs, uncover growth opportunities, overcome objections, and build solutions aligned to operational, technology, and financial priorities.
* **Maintain disciplined CRM and forecast accuracy.** Track pipeline, account activity, deal stage, next steps, expected close timing, and revenue impact with consistency and accuracy.
* **Protect customer relationships.** Serve as a trusted business advisor who can coordinate across service, sales, technical, and partner resources to help customers succeed.

**What you’ll Bring**

  

* 5+ years of successful outside B2B sales experience, preferably with complex accounts, telecommunications, technology, SaaS, mobility, wired solutions, or business services.
* Documented success meeting or exceeding quota in a full-cycle sales role that required prospecting, account growth, negotiation, and closing.
* Ability to manage both sales and account-maintenance demands without losing focus on pipeline creation and revenue growth.
* Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex product sets, internal processes, wired and mobility terminology, and solution-design concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to work through internal teams, sales engineers, partner channels, and cross-functional resources to solve customer problems.
* Strong territory, account planning, pipeline management, prioritization, and forecasting discipline.
* Comfortable competing in a market where customers evaluate multiple providers, vendors, resellers, and channel options.
* Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and reliable transportation for market coverage.
* Bachelor’s degree is preferred, or equivalent combination of relevant sales experience and demonstrated performance.

Join a sales organization where complex account ownership, technical growth, and customer impact matter. In Platinum, you will manage meaningful business relationships, compete in a sophisticated market, and partner across sales engineering, mobility, wired, indirect, and support teams to solve customer problems. This role is designed for experienced sellers who want more than transactional selling: it offers the challenge of balancing account strategy, service demands, technical solutioning, and new revenue growth. In addition to competitive pay and commission, AT&T offers paid training, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, wellness programs, and career development resources designed to support long-term success.

**Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act**

Candidates with arrest or convictions records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Relevant Material Job Duties for which Criminal History may have a direct adverse, and negative relationship potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the Conditional Offer of Employment:

* Contact with Customers/

Growing a food and beverage business takes more than introducing a product. It takes understanding what customers will buy, helping operators select the right assortment, and following through so new placements become repeat orders.

G & J Marketing and Sales is looking for an experienced, self-directed salesperson based in Los Angeles, CA to actively cover the territory across vending, micro markets, office coffee, and pantry service.

**Develop New Business**  
Identify prospective customers, arrange meetings, and secure new product placements. Present food and beverage options that fit each customer’s operation, consumer preferences, and sales goals.

**Grow Existing Accounts**  
Understand what each account purchases and where there is room to expand. Introduce additional products, support relevant promotions, and follow up on results to build repeat business.

**Represent Our Manufacturer Partners**  
Know the products, pricing, and programs you represent. Give customers accurate information and work with G & J’s National Sales Managers on opportunities that need additional supplier support.

**Manage Your Territory**  
Determine your daily schedule, sales approach, priorities, and methods within the defined territory and applicable brand standards. Keep customer activity and opportunities current in the CRM, and use sales reports to guide account follow-up.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* Retain and grow the existing business within the territory
* Add customers and expand product distribution within current accounts
* Turn new placements and promotions into repeat purchases
* Maintain a current pipeline and follow through on customer commitments
* Grow territory sales and commission earnings through active account development

**Who This Role Is Ideal For**

This role is suited to an experienced salesperson who enjoys working directly with customers and wants to manage a defined territory independently.

You are comfortable asking for the business, following up after a meeting, and staying involved after the first order. You recognize opportunities within existing accounts as well as with new customers.

Experience with CPG, foodservice, vending, office coffee, or distribution is valuable. You understand how product selection, availability, and consistent service influence a customer’s buying decisions.

You can organize your work without daily direction and are comfortable with earnings tied to sales performance. You want an established customer base to develop while taking responsibility for the business you build.

* Organization and consistent follow-through across multiple accounts and opportunities
* Comfort using CRM tools, sales reports, and virtual meetings to support field sales
* Experience in CPG, foodservice, brokerage, or related channels; local industry relationships a plus

**Compensation Structure**

This is a sales performance role with commission-based compensation tied to the sales you generate and actively service. The territory includes existing business already generating commissions, with additional earning potential through new accounts, expanded distribution, and growth within current customers.

Compensation reflects sales performance, account growth, and customer retention. You determine how to organize and develop your business within the defined territory.

* Educates guests on the benefits and usage of products to support their at-home care routine.
* Partners with stylists to reinforce product recommendations during checkout.

* Engages and actively listens; ensures guests feel supported, and excited to return.

* Communicates effectively with guests to confirm appointments and answer questions.
* Supports a positive team environment by collaborating with stylists, managers, and fellow Customer Experience Specialists.
* Upholds a high standard of hospitality that reflects the salon's commitment to quality in every detail.

**General Operations**

* Meets or exceeds company attendance and on-time standards.
* Participates in ongoing skills development through company and/or vendor provided training and skill practice.
* Promotes and supports events that drive traffic, client engagement, and service bookings.
* Participates in team meetings and training to stay aligned with salon goals.
* Ensures front desk operations run smoothly, including accurate scheduling, guest check in and out and payment processing.
* Upholds salon cleanliness and organization standards within front desk and salon retail area.
* Handles phone and in person inquiries with efficiency and professionalism.
* Supports inventory management by tracking product levels, restocking retail shelves and alerting leadership of low stock.
* Follows salon policies and procedures, including safety, sanitation, and compliance protocols.

**Qualifications:**

If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\*, and 401(k) with Company match. TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. **A Brief Overview**  
As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at TriNet you will serve as the face of a well established, reputable company that empowers the small business community to focus on what matters most – growing their business. **What you will do**

* Secure meetings with the right people, at the right place, at the right time to create high quality sales opportunities for the field sales team.

* Use internal sales tools and resources to execute a high touch sales cadence on prospects.

* Make around 80 cold calls a day to prospects to gauge interest.

* Execute a follow-up strategy on prospects that were not interested but maybe in the future or were interested but did not buy.

* Develop new sales strategies based on personal successes and failures and share what’s working with your peers!

* Complies with all policies and standards

* High School Diploma required or

* Bachelor's Degree preferred

**Experience Qualifications**

* Typically, < 1 year Sales prospecting and research preferred

**Skills and Abilities**

* Articulate and persuasive written and oral communicator (Intermediate proficiency)

* Demonstrate willingness to grow through discomfort – fearless! (Intermediate proficiency)

* Seeks out, internalizes, and applies coaching feedback (Intermediate proficiency)

* Strong work ethic and self-drive (Intermediate proficiency)

* A believer in the fruits of a disciplined process (Intermediate proficiency)

* Strong attention to detail and highly organized (Intermediate proficiency)

* Great active-listening skills (Intermediate proficiency)

* Ability to maintain a positive attitude in the face of rejection and failure (Intermediate proficiency)

* Enjoys collaborating with internal and cross-functional teams (Intermediate proficiency)

* Strong computer literacy skills (Intermediate proficiency)

* Experience using a CRM; Salesforce preferred (Intermediate proficiency)

* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace (Intermediate proficiency)

**Travel Requirements**  
Minimal  
  
**Work Environment**

* Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable office or home setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The preferred location for this role is Irvine, CA, and the salary range for this location is $22.00 to $27.69. All qualified external applicants will be considered for an in-office role, based in Irvine. All qualified internal candidates are encouraged to apply and consider relocation to Irvine and may be considered for remote hire at the company’s discretion. The candidate’s final salary offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, education, work location and experience.

Candidates hired into roles in the sales organization are also eligible for commissions consistent with TriNet’s commission plan.

Additionally, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, TriNet offers permanent full-time employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(K) savings plan, an employee stock purchase plan, eleven (11) Company observed holidays, PTO and a comprehensive leave program. new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

Monarch Plumbing & Rooter, Inc. is a growing local plumbing company committed to providing reliable service and high-quality solutions to our customers. As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a creative, motivated, and highly efficient Marketing Coordinator / Content & Brand Specialist to take an active role in developing and managing our company's marketing.

**Position Overview**

This is a hands-on marketing position responsible for supporting and managing all aspects of Monarch Plumbing & Rooter's marketing—from our online presence and social media to photography, video production, advertising, printed materials, field marketing, branding, and community outreach.

A major part of this position will involve creating original photo and video content. This individual should be comfortable going into the field, photographing and recording our technicians, projects, equipment, company events, before-and-after work, and other content that can be used to market the company.

The person in this position will also be responsible for turning that raw content into professional, engaging marketing material through photo editing, video editing, graphic design, and content creation.

We are looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for marketing assignments. We want someone who can identify opportunities, develop ideas, and take those ideas from concept through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist with developing and executing the company's overall marketing strategy.
* Manage the company's social media presence and content calendar.
* Create, schedule, and publish engaging social media content.
* Photograph and record company projects, technicians, equipment, events, and other marketing opportunities.
* Travel to local job sites when needed to capture high-quality photos and video content.
* Plan and produce before-and-after content, project highlights, educational videos, employee features, promotional videos, and other creative content.
* Edit photos and videos for social media, advertising, website content, and other marketing materials.
* Create short-form video content such as Instagram Reels, TikTok-style videos, and other social media content.
* Maintain an organized library of company photos, videos, graphics, and other marketing assets.
* Develop graphics, flyers, brochures, mailers, advertisements, signage, and promotional materials.
* Help maintain and improve the company's presence across Google, Yelp, social media, and other online platforms.
* Assist with website content and identify opportunities to improve the company's online presence.
* Develop marketing campaigns and promotions to help generate leads and increase customer engagement.
* Maintain consistent company branding across digital platforms, vehicles, uniforms, signage, printed materials, and advertising.
* Assist with email and customer marketing campaigns.
* Help develop strategies to increase positive customer reviews and online engagement.
* Research local advertising, sponsorship, partnership, and community outreach opportunities.
* Assist with company events, community events, sponsorships, and promotional activities.
* Research competitors and current marketing trends to identify new opportunities.
* Track marketing campaigns and results to determine what is generating leads and producing results.
* Work closely with office staff, management, and field technicians to identify and create marketing opportunities.
* Take ownership of marketing projects from initial idea through completion.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Previous experience in marketing, content creation, social media, or a related field.
* Photography experience and a strong understanding of how to capture professional-quality images.
* Videography experience and the ability to confidently record high-quality video content.
* Experience with photo and video editing software.
* Ability to create polished, engaging content from raw photos and video footage.
* Experience creating content for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
* Graphic design experience and familiarity with programs such as Canva, Adobe or similar design platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Comfortable working with Google Workspace and other digital platforms.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Comfortable working both in an office environment and visiting job sites to capture content.

**Additional Skills That Are a Plus**

Experience in any of the following areas is a plus:

* Digital advertising and paid social media campaigns
* Google Ads
* Google Business Profile
* Yelp business marketing
* SEO and local search marketing
* Website content management
* Email marketing
* Graphic design
* Branding and brand development
* Marketing analytics and performance tracking
* Community outreach and event marketing
* Home-service, construction, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or similar service-industry marketing

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is creative, highly efficient, resourceful, organized, and proactive.

This person should have a creative eye and be able to recognize marketing opportunities in everyday company operations. Whether it's a technician completing an interesting project, a before-and-after transformation, new equipment arriving, a community event, or an opportunity to educate customers, we want someone who can recognize that opportunity and turn it into quality content.

The ideal candidate:

* Thinks creatively and outside the box.
* Has a strong eye for photography, video, design, and visual presentation.
* Understands how to create content that captures people's attention

new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

The Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene, Inc. is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Part-Time Research Coordinator to support a pilot study examining cannabis use and HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) engagement among young adults. * Contribute and/or lead secondary data analyses

* Knowledge of or interest in HIV prevention, PrEP, cannabis use, behavioral health, or health disparities

new_jobs.description:
Are you a recent college grad or professional looking to transform lives through medical communications? Are you ready for a rewarding career in a collaborative and growing environment? We're hiring a savvy **Program Coordinator** passionate about keeping projects on task and their team focused.

**About You**

* You are flexible and confident you can manage up to 20 projects at a time and be responsible for the project development process.
* You are solution-oriented and can anticipate potential workflow obstacles and provide solutions.
* You're highly organized, a self-starter with an eye for the details and a pulse on the bottom line.
* You flourish in fast-paced environments and relish the particulars.
* You work passionately, never satisfied with the status quo.
* You're a born problem-solver and enjoy when no day is the same.

**Your Day-to-Day**

As a Program Coordinator, you will track project deliverables through all departments, ensure due dates are relayed, and obstacles are identified and communicated efficiently. You will be responsible for running your clients medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) process. This includes submissions, coordinating with taggers, and communicating status updates to the client, the MLR Supervisor, and your supporting team. In addition, you will oversee coordinating internal and external meeting, taking meeting notes during meetings, and providing status updates to the team.

Under supervision from a program manager, you will review invoicing documents and final reconciliations, prepare Sunshine Act reports and any ancillary reports as required by the client. You will work closely with the logistics vendor to perform meeting planning tasks, including site search, venue contracting, travel arrangements, food/beverage, and AV equipment. You will be responsible for preparing and distributing the assignment report and facilitating assignment team meetings.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor's degree, ideally with a concentration in advertising, marketing, communications, or journalism; other majors will be considered
* 0-2 years of prior work experience in a client service/agency setting or related internship experience
* A high level of computer competency and intermediate or advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, and Outlook)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Helpful Experience**

* Working knowledge of timeline and schedule development
* Experience supporting a project manager or marketing team with coordinating tasks and tracking deadlines

**Who We Are**

Precision AQ - Medical Communications was founded with the simple belief that the scientific story is the foundation of every pharmaceutical brand. Our teams of inquisitive problem solvers and passionate creators dig deep to translate the science behind today's cutting-edge therapies, then communicate the science clearly and credibly. Our proven track record of long-tenured relationships with major pharmaceutical companies and leading bio-tech firms, and our inclusive, open-minded team culture are industry leading. This passionate work environment, paired with growth opportunity, professional development, compensation, and benefits, are why Precision AQ - Medical Communications was recognized as a Best Place to Work by the Philadelphia Business Journal for the last three years.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Events & Administrative Coordinator

**Reports to:** Managing Director, Development

**About Commonpoint:**

Rooted in community and driven by possibility, Commonpoint meets the evolving needs of New Yorkers at every stage of life. More than 125,000 people turn to Commonpoint each year through our eleven flagship locations and nearly 100 co located program sites – for opportunities to learn and thrive, support in moments of crisis, and pathways to stronger, more secure futures.

From early childhood through older adulthood, Commonpoint is there for everyday life – and for the moments when life gets hard. Rooted in Jewish values, we serve New Yorkers of all backgrounds and abilities, creating opportunities to learn, play, connect and belong while helping individuals and families navigate challenges with the support and resources they need.

**Position Summary:**

The Events & Administrative Coordinator provides administrative, operational, and event support across Commonpoint’s Development division, which brings together fundraising and donor engagement, volunteerism, and Jewish heritage and cultural arts. The Coordinator works across these areas to support the planning and execution of events, programs, fundraising activities, and other team priorities.

A significant focus of the role is event and program planning and logistics – from advance planning and coordination through day-of execution and follow-up. This includes volunteer programs, donor cultivation and stewardship events, fundraising events, and cultural arts programs.

***For 40 years, Haitian Centers Council (HCC) has served as a trusted community resource for underserved and vulnerable populations, including immigrants, seniors, and low-income individuals. HCC provides free educational programs, healthcare linkages, prevention services, and social support to the Caribbean community regardless of economic status. Guided by the needs and voices of those it serves, HCC has spent four decades fostering a stronger, more resilient community by promoting equity, addressing health and racial disparities, and collaborating with community partners. At its core, HCC believes that wellness begins with self-care and the creation of safe, inclusive environments where everyone can thrive.***  
  
**Program Overview**

The Young Men Who Have Sex with Men (YMSM) Program provides comprehensive, community-based HIV prevention, sexual health education, and navigation services for young men who have sex with men. The program utilizes evidence based, harm reduction, and culturally responsive strategies to reduce HIV and HCV transmission, increase access to biomedical prevention, and address barriers to care.

**Purpose of the Position**

The Health Navigator / Outreach Worker is responsible for engaging YMSM through targeted outreach, delivering rapid testing services, facilitating group-level interventions, supporting drop-in programming, and providing navigation and linkage to HIV prevention and care services. This role ensures participants have access to prevention resources, supportive services, and a welcoming, affirming space.

*Key Responsibilities*

**Outreach & Community Engagement**

* Conduct community outreach a minimum of three (3) times per week, specifically targeting YMSM, in physical and virtual spaces.

* Identify and prioritize outreach efforts in areas with high HIV infection rates using local NYS ETE dashboard data.

* Provide culturally affirming education on HIV, HCV, STI prevention, sexual health, and risk-reduction strategies.

* Work at least one (1) Saturday per month and one (1) evening per month to support outreach or agency-wide programming.

  

**Testing & Screening Services**

* Provide rapid HIV and Hepatitis C (HCV) testing in community-based, wellness center, and mobile health unit settings.

* Conduct pre- and post-test counseling per NYSDOH and agency protocols.

* Ensure informed consent, confidentiality, and accurate documentation.

  
**Navigation, Referrals & Linkage to Care**  

* Provide health navigation to support access to PrEP, PEP, STI testing, HIV/HCV medical care, and supportive services.

* Address barriers such as insurance, transportation, and system navigation.

* Facilitate warm handoffs and follow-up.

  

**Group-Level Interventions & Education**

* Co-facilitate evidence-based intervention such as, Popular Opinion Leader.

* Support recruitment and engagement for group activities and workshops.

  

**Drop-In Activities & Wellness Center Support**

* Support and facilitate drop-in activities designed to promote engagement, retention, and community building among YMSM.

* Provide informal education, resource navigation, and referrals during drop-in hours.

* Ensure the wellness center is stocked and organized with essential materials, including but not limited to:

* MetroCards and transportation assistance

* Snacks and beverages

* Hygiene kits and safer sex supplies

* Educational and outreach materials

* Monitor inventory levels and communicate restocking needs to supervisors.

* Maintain a welcoming, affirming, and safe environment during all drop-in programming.

  

**Data Entry, Documentation & Quality Assurance**

* Enter all outreach, testing, navigation, and drop-in service data by the end of each business week.

* Perform self-audits of testing forms and service documentation.

* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA, NYSDOH, and agency policies.

  

**Training & Professional Development**

* Attend a minimum of twelve (12) trainings per contract year.

* Participate in supervision, staff meetings, and professional development.

Service (TaPaaS) agency with approx. 350 people globally, we're not just advising clients - we're

building the technology that transforms how businesses connect with their buyers.

**Role:**

You will support the day-to-day of client relationships and media activity, working with the

wider team to meet client marketing and business objectives - translating these into clear media

interrogate briefs, identify opportunities to improve performance, and ultimately help clients

You’ll also play an important role in developing more junior members of the team and creating a

collaborative, proactive account culture.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present

Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital advertising solutions with the goal of helping consumers find and discover products and services. Amazon Adapt is a program designed to offer coverage solutions for business gaps which may occur due to extended leave (parental, medical) and unexpected account transitions. Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients.

*This role is hybrid and can be located near an Aon office.*

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

You'll work closely with clients, surety carriers, and internal collaborators to deliver bond programs with accuracy, compliance, and outstanding service. This role involves significant client interaction and ownership of key accounts. It offers the chance to create an immediate impact while further developing your expertise in the specialized field of surety.

  

* Works under minimal supervision, exercising good judgment in routine and moderately complex client and market situations.
* Takes primary accountability in managing selected accounts.
* Possesses a working knowledge of surety bonds, including bond program structures, indemnity concepts, and market practices including accurate client interaction and advisement.
* May assist in onboarding, mentoring, and training internal team.
* Works closely with carriers every day to address evolving needs. Prepares and processes various surety instruments, such as bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds. Ensures these align with underwriting guidelines and client expectations.
* Collaborates with clients daily to meet their changing requirements. Implements Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other obligations required by clients in line with State rules. Determines the necessary documents to complete issuance, including power-of-attorney, resident license, and others, ensuring attention to contractual, legal, and financial details.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications. Coordinates with and advises clients to acquire complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review. This includes any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
* Maintains and supports data accuracy and promotes proactive oversight of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).
* Works closely with internal collaborators to implement and ensure accurate, complete electronic bond files in AonBondLink (ABL). Also confirms and manages related client financial and underwriting records while following internal controls and audit requirements to prevent E&O.
* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety mentorship and support to non-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal collaborators.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority. Assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests exceeding standard limits or outside delegated authority.

**How this opportunity is different**

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in process improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

We're looking for a Community Manager to own Pure's day-to-day social media presence and build an engaged community around the brand. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn an idea into a post, keep a content calendar moving, and make our channels feel active and worth following. You'll create and publish content, respond to our audience, and use performance data and community feedback to improve what we put out. Social media management is the primary focus, with community engagement woven into the daily work.

This role is based full-time in our New York City office.

**You will:**

* Own the social content calendar and day-to-day publishing across channels such as Instagram, TikTok, and X, adapting the format, copy, and timing to each platform
* Create and edit social content, including short-form videos, captions, stories, memes, and simple graphics; work with designers and video editors when additional production support is needed
* Manage comments, mentions, and direct messages with a consistent brand voice; answer common questions, encourage conversation, and route account or payment issues to the appropriate support team
* Spot relevant trends, player stories, and conversations in poker, gaming, and internet culture, and turn them into timely content that fits Pure's audience and brand
* Coordinate with marketing, product, and creator partnerships on launches, announcements, events, and creator content; manage asset collection, approvals, and publishing deadlines
* Track reach, engagement, shares, saves, video watch time, audience growth, and referral traffic; report on what is working and test new formats, hooks, and posting times

* Experience managing social media accounts for a brand, startup, creator, or community, with examples of content you created and results you helped drive
* Strong writing and editing skills, a feel for internet culture, and the ability to adapt a brand's voice across posts, comments, and direct messages
* Comfortable shooting and editing short-form video and making simple social assets with tools such as CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite

new_jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
As a **Field Sales Representative** at the Pittsburgh Paints Company (PPC) supporting The Home Depot, you will cultivate and execute sales plans and selling PPC products through several of the Home Depot stores. Primary end-use customers will include multi-family maintenance, facilities maintenance, residential repaint, hospitality and government.

You will be assigned Pro Managed Accounts within a territory and have responsibility for organic growth and new customer acquisition and development. You will work onsite in the **Syosset, NY** territory and report to the Regional Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with The Home Depot management teams to develop and achieve sales growth plans.
* Engage customers throughout The Home Depot store looking to uncover opportunities to introduce PPC products.
* Utilize a Customer Relationship Management Tool (CRM) – you will increase sales growth of the PRO customers' list of accounts.
* Analyze territory sales performance reports and develop strategic territory business plans to support growth.
* Identify in-store selling opportunities to secure wing stacks, bulk stacks, end caps, and stack outs to create impactful, cross merchandised, product displays.
* Ensure automatic replenishment system (CAR) is supplying product to support rate of sale, and on-hand inventory counts are accurate by performing cycle counts.
* Maintain color centers and perform shelf maintenance of all products in addition to completing resets of shelves and product during Product Line Reviews.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred.
* 1 Year of experience can include educational classes and/or internships.
* This position is based on a 50-hour work week which includes base salary and overtime.
* Valid driver's license and a clean driving record.

*Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without employment-based visa sponsorship (now or in the future). This includes H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visas).*

  

*PPC Participates in a Fixed and Variable Rate (FAVR) program. With FAVR, you drive your own car and receive tax-free reimbursements that cover both fixed costs (like insurance) and variable costs (like gas), giving you more choice and equity in your vehicle.*

*The anticipated base salary range for this position is $50,000 - $55,000 annually. This position is also eligible for incentive compensation, including commissions and/or bonuses, subject to applicable plan terms.*

**Description**

Assistant Project Manager (LIRR)

Delivery/LIRR

Project Manager

Open Until Filled

MTA Construction & Development reserves the right to remove this posting before the application deadline.

**Agency Mission**

MTA Construction & Development (C&D) is responsible for the planning, development, and execution of all capital construction projects across the MTA region. Through centralized oversight and management of the MTA’s $64 billion Capital Program, C&D ensures the efficient delivery of critical infrastructure projects that support the region’s vast transportation network. As part of the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, the largest transportation network in North America, C&D plays a key role in modernizing and expanding services that support 15.3 million residents across New York City, Long Island, southeastern New York State, and Connecticut. C&D is committed to delivering safe, innovative, and cost-effective capital projects that enhance the customer experience and strengthen the reliability and resilience of the MTA system.

**Telework**

This position is eligible for telework, which is currently one day per week. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.

**Job** **S****ummary**

The Assistant Project Manager manages capital project delivery within the LIRR business unit in the MTA Construction Development (C&D) Delivery Department. This position is part of the project management team responsible for ensuring that project delivery is safe, efficient, on schedule, within budget, and according to project documents, contractual requirements, and relevant policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.

The Assistant Project Manager monitors project status and identifies project risks and issues. This position assists the Project Manager with management, coordination, field oversight, and inspection of capital projects. This position coordinates daily project delivery activities with C&D staff, contractors, consultants, and agency forces to support the safe and efficient execution of capital projects.

**Responsibilities**

The Assistant Project Manager is responsible for successfully managing and mentoring staff to deliver complex capital projects.

Coordinate project activities through project close-out.

Monitor project performance against established baselines and pursue opportunities for improved performance.

Identify project issues and risks and ensure timely resolution and mitigation.

Recommend solutions to senior management for the resolution of critical issues.

Manage project activities to minimize the impact on agency operations and the public.
