new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Caliber Car Wash was founded in 2018 in Atlanta, GA. The goal of the founders was to build a “best in class” car wash company with a focus on improving the customer experience. Today, the company operates with 64 locations throughout the southeast US and Texas. The company has a projected growth to 100+ Stores in the next 3 years! Caliber is dedicated to the communities they serve through superior customer service. If you are a solutions-oriented, proactive, service industry leader, seeking an opportunity with a growing organization that cares about its people; we need to talk!

**Our Purpose**

Caliber exists to *Improve People’s Lives* by providing career opportunities and professional growth to our team members and by providing exceptional service worth our customer’s loyalty.

**Role Summary**

The Field Marketing Specialist is an on-site marketing generalist who keeps marketing running at store level and in the field: coordination, organic social, signage and in-store execution, and local store marketing. Reports to the VP, Marketing; executes on the ground while Creative, CRM, and paid own their lanes. Works in person at Atlanta-area stores and digitally supports and coordinates activations for all Caliber locations.

This role exists to make marketing easier for the field, not to add to its workload. Success means district and site managers trust marketing, call marketing when something happens, and see results at their stores. The ideal candidate has experience running grassroots and local store marketing for a multi-unit retail or service brand; is hands-on, detail-oriented, and operator-minded; and expects to spend real time in the field working with field operations teams.

Car wash may not be the first industry that comes to mind for a marketing career, and that is exactly the opportunity. Express car wash is a fast-growing, membership-driven business built on the same subscription model that powers streaming, software, and fitness brands. In this role, you’ll see firsthand

how recurring revenue works: acquiring members, converting single-wash customers, and reducing churn, all measured store by store. Few early-career roles combine hands-on local marketing with subscription business experience, and both skill sets carry into any industry you choose next.

**Responsibilities**

The essential functions of this role include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Drive local store marketing and grassroots activation that lifts store traffic.

Leverage a trade-area profile for each store (schools, employers, apartments, competitors, events) and turn it into activity: fundraisers with schools, teams, and nonprofits; affinity program activations; business, apartment, and other local partnerships; and community events. Work from a ready-to-use play menu designed around the situational needs of individual car wash locations. Diagnose before prescribing, prioritize stores by need rather than spreading effort evenly, and measure through predetermined KPIs and store-level lift.

* Own store-level marketing execution across signage, merchandising, and promotions.

Coordinate signage needs from a catalog; manage promo swaps, new-store and refresh rollouts, POS screen content, digital menus / reader boards, in-store merchandising, and store audits to ensure campaigns are live and accurate.

* Creatively produce organic social and community content as needed.
* Coordinate field marketing requests and cross-functional follow-through.

Serve as the marketing intake point for district and site managers. Turn field signals into action and close the loop on every request. Coordinate with Creative, CRM, paid media, Ops, IT, vendors, and webstore partners.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Degree not required, but a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, public relations, business, or a related field is preferred. In its place, relevant experience, creativity, and curiosity carry equal weight.
* 1–3 years of field, local, retail, or multi-unit marketing experience is a plus.
* Experience in a multi-unit, high-growth environment preferred. Car wash, QSR, or retail operations experience is a bonus.
* **Creative and curious:** brings fresh ideas and is eager to learn what works at each site and why.
* **Operator-minded:** understands, or is eager to learn, what moves a site (cars per day, membership conversion, churn, weather, staffing) and how much a marketing ask means to a busy site team.
* **Field partnership:** builds trust with district and site managers; translates needs into action and prioritizes well.
* **Generalist range & organization:** owns many small tasks without dropping details; manages multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* **Eye for design:** knows what looks right and on-brand, from signage and merchandising to social content and creative direction, and spots what’s offat a site and gets it fixed.
* **AI-assisted:** uses AI tools where appropriate to move faster (project management, admin, first drafts, and creative brainstorming, but never the final product).
* **Effective communicator:** collaborates across all levels of the organization; is proactive and comfortable sharing opinions in group settings.
* **Understands concept-to-impact:** takes an idea from first concept through execution to measurable results, and can point to activations, events, or programs they’ve led in any educational, community, or business setting.

**Tools & Metrics**

* **Tools & systems**: Microsoft Office Suite, Claude, Canva, organic social schedulers, Google Business Profile / Yext listings, and a project tracker. Car wash-specific systems include Rinsed (CRM), DRB and Sonny’s (POS), and digital menu boards; no prior experience is expected, and training is provided.
* **Success metrics**: DM request turnaround, prioritization, and close-out rate; field satisfaction (quarterly DM pulse); signage and menu accuracy; promo rollout accuracy; n

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative, MultiPro Property Solutions
new_jobs.description:
**Win Business. Fuel Growth. Grow Your Career.**

Are you a driven, results-oriented sales professional with a hunter mentality? Join our fast-paced team and play a key role in building strong client relationships and driving business growth!

We’re looking for a Business Development Representative who is ready to hustle, hunt, and close. In this role, you’ll focus on generating new business, expanding market share, and building revenue pipelines. If you’re a self-starter with a competitive mindset and a drive to dominate your market, this is the role for you!

**Compensation & Work Environment Details:**

**On-Target Earnings (OTE):** $114,000 - $120,000 per year

**Competitive starting salary from:** $59,000+

**Monthly Commission:** Uncapped

**Auto Allowance & Reimbursement:** Bi-weekly fixed contribution + monthly variable mileage reimbursement

**Work Environment:** Field-based/remote role with up to 75% travel within your territory

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Drive New Business:** Identify, engage, and secure new clients through property visits, outbound prospecting, cold calling, referrals, and networking efforts.
* **Expand & Retain Accounts:** Build trusted relationships with clients, expanding service offerings based on their needs.
* **Promote Our Services:** Educate clients and property teams on MultiPro’s full suite of make ready, repair & maintenance, and property improvement services, as well as Valet Living capabilities.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Partner with operations and internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding, project execution, and client satisfaction.
* **Manage Proposals & Bids:** Develop tailored proposals, coordinate project handoffs, and support the adoption of Annual Price Agreements.
* **Support Service Launches:** Help define job scopes, service protocols, and ensure successful community and project launches.
* **Represent MultiPro:** Attend industry events, trade shows, and client meetings to grow market presence.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* **Sales Experience:** 2+ years of outside sales experience, preferably in the services or construction industry. B2B transactional sales experience is a plus.
* **Proven Track Record:** Strong history of securing new clients and growing accounts through cold calling, cross-selling, and referrals.
* **Solution-Based Sales Expertise:** Proficient in asking insightful questions and identifying pain points to influence and engage decision-makers, offering customized solutions at all levels.
* **Market Insight:** Ability to analyze market trends and client needs to drive tailored solutions.
* **CRM Proficiency:** Experience managing pipelines and driving results using CRM tools (Salesforce preferred).
* **Negotiation Skills:** Advanced skills in persuasion, motivation, and closing deals.
* **Strong Communicator:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* **Tech-Savvy:** Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn new platforms quickly.
* **Professional & Driven:** High level of professionalism, accountability, and ethical decision-making.
* **Team Player:** Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and adapt in dynamic environments.
* **Valid Driver’s License:** This role requires frequent travel within your designated market.

**Why You’ll Love Working with Us:**

Work hard, grow fast. At MultiPro Property Solutions, we recognize talent, reward ambition, and promote from within. If you’re looking for a place where effort leads to opportunity, innovation is encouraged, and leadership is earned, you’ve found it.

**Robust Training Program:**

* 4-week structured onboarding program to set you up for success
* Hands-on mentorship and ongoing support

**Comprehensive Benefits:**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you & your family, plus HSA with employer contributions and Flexible Spending Accounts
* **Flexible Time Off:** No preset accruals—manage your time and work-life balance your way, plus 10 company-paid holidays.
* **Financial Security:** 401k with company match, life and disability insurance, AD&D, and business travel coverage
* **Professional Development:** Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 per year and access to our online education center
* **Additional Perks:** Referral bonuses, pet insurance, associate assistance programs, discount programs, rewards, recognition, and free access to Torch Fitness virtual programs

The final compensation offered will be determined based on various factors, including the candidate's location, level of experience, and skill set. As such, it may fall outside the range listed above. OTE varies based on performance.

The application window is anticipated to close 60 days from the date the job is posted.

**Ready to grow your sales career with a team that values your drive and talent? Apply today and help us deliver exceptional service to the clients who depend on us**

**#LI-AC1**

Are you a current Valet Living employee? If so, click here to apply.

MultiPro Property Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values the strength diversity brings to the workplace. new_jobs.description:
**About us**

Crabapple Martial Arts Academy is a family-focused martial arts school in Milton, GA (the Crabapple / Alpharetta area). We teach children and families focus, confidence, discipline, and respect — skills that show up in the classroom, at home, and for life. We're the flagship school of a growing martial-arts company, so there's real room to grow with us.

**The opportunity**

We're hiring a Sales and Enrollment Representative to be the person who brings new families through our doors. You'll start by getting our name into the community and booking families for their first lesson. As you prove yourself, you'll grow into closing new enrollments and selling our long-term programs — with your pay growing at every step. This is for someone who loves people, loves to win, and wants their income to reflect their results.

**What you'll do**

* Build interest in the community through school events, local partnerships, and referral events
* Follow up with interested families and book qualified appointments for a first lesson
* Reconnect with past families through friendly outreach
* Keep our lead-tracking system accurate and up to date
* As you grow: lead enrollment conversations, sign new families, and guide current families into our long-term programs

**How you'll grow — and earn more**

This role is built in stages. You start by filling our pipeline and booking appointments. Once you do that consistently, we add enrollment and commission on every family you sign. Once you've proven that, we add our long-term program sales — the highest-earning part of the job. Each stage adds responsibility and pay.

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years in a goal-driven, customer-facing role (sales, membership or enrollment sales, business development, recruiting, real estate, hospitality, or similar)
* Comfortable starting conversations with new people and following up professionally
* Organized, reliable, and able to work on-site including some evenings and weekends
* Genuinely warm with children and parents
* Able to pass a background check (we work with kids)

**Nice to have**

* Experience in martial arts, fitness, youth programs, or another membership business
* Familiarity with a CRM or lead-tracking tool
* Roots in the Milton / Alpharetta community

**Compensation**

* $48,000 base salary, steady from day one
* Monthly performance bonus while you build the pipeline
* Uncapped commission as you take on enrollment and long-term sales
* Milestone bonuses tied to the academy's growth
* Typical first-year earnings around $60,000; top performers $90,000–$125,000+

Pay: From $48,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**About Undaunted**

Undaunted is an Atlanta-based robotic security startup that helps apartment communities keep their residents safe. Founded in 2025 in the Atlanta Ventures studio, we already run the largest fleet of quadruped security robots in the country. We're a small team that moves fast, and we're growing.

**The Role**

This is a phone-first, outbound sales role. You'll call multifamily property owners and management companies, build relationships with decision-makers, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. You'll work directly with our Head of Sales and CEO.

We care more about drive than resume. If you outwork the people around you and don't take "no" personally, we'll teach you the rest.

**What You'll Do**

* Make outbound calls, emails, and follow-ups to property management companies and asset managers
* Book meetings with property managers, directors of operations, and VP-level decision-makers
* Qualify inbound leads and hand them off with full context
* Keep your activity and pipeline up to date in the CRM
* Help sharpen our messaging and targeting
* Represent Undaunted at local industry and networking events

**What We're Looking For**

* 0–2 years in sales, SDR/BDR, or any high-volume customer-facing job
* No sales experience? Sports, the military, service jobs, or a side hustle all count
* You like being on the phone and can talk to anyone
* Clear, confident communicator on calls and in writing
* Self-starter who hits daily activity goals without being chased
* Reliable and on time, with dependable transportation in the Atlanta area

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in real estate, property management, or multifamily
* Interest in robotics, security tech, or startups
* Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar CRM

**Paid Two-Week Trial**

Every new SDR starts with a paid two-week trial. You'll train, shadow the team, then get on the phones. We're looking for effort, coachability, and your first booked meetings. Hit the bar and you're offered the full-time role.

**Compensation**

* $50,000 base salary
* Uncapped commission on meetings and pipeline you create
* $75,000 on-target earnings, with top performers earning more

**Our Values**

* **Customer-First:** we go any length to make our customers happy
* **Team over Self:** the team's goals come before ego

* **Scrappy:** speed and iteration beat perfection

**Founding Sales Growth Advisor – Software (Remote)**

$20k – $100k

Founding Sales Growth Advisor – Software (Remote)

Help Build the Future of Business Technology

Arriv Global is building an interconnected ecosystem of business technology designed to help organizations communicate, sell, recruit, hire, train, manage teams, and grow more efficiently.

We're looking for ambitious, relationship-driven individuals to join our founding software sales team and help introduce businesses to the growing Arriv ecosystem.

If you enjoy building relationships, learning technology, solving business problems, and creating opportunities, we'd love to meet you.

Why Join Arriv?

This isn't just another software sales position.

You'll be joining an early-stage technology company where you'll work closely with the founder and help shape how our sales organization grows.

Our founding Sales Growth Advisors aren't simply stepping into an established sales department and following an old playbook.

You'll help build the playbook.

As Arriv expands its technology, customer base, and markets, our founding sales team will help influence future sales strategies, processes, territory development, and growth initiatives.

If you've ever wanted the opportunity to help build a technology company from the ground up, this is your opportunity.

What You'll Represent

Sales Growth Advisors may introduce businesses to authorized solutions within the growing Arriv ecosystem, including:

Arriv One – AI-powered business communication, sales, CRM, calling, messaging, and workflow technology

Khetha IQ – recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and workforce technology

Arriv Payroll – payroll and compensation solutions designed to integrate with business operations

Additional Arriv products and services as the ecosystem continues to expand

Rather than selling disconnected software products, you'll help businesses understand how different parts of the Arriv ecosystem can work together to solve real operational challenges.

What You'll Do

As an Arriv Sales Growth Advisor, you'll:

Build relationships with business owners, executives, managers, and decision-makers.

Introduce organizations to Arriv's software and technology solutions.

Conduct discovery conversations to understand how businesses currently operate.

Identify problems, inefficiencies, and opportunities where Arriv technology may help.

Recommend appropriate Arriv solutions based on each organization's actual needs.

Conduct virtual product conversations, demonstrations, and presentations.

Generate new business through networking, referrals, phone calls, email, social outreach, and approved local outreach.

Build and manage your own sales pipeline.

Follow up with prospective customers throughout the sales process.

Develop long-term relationships with the accounts you originate.

Maintain accurate sales and customer activity records.

Represent Arriv professionally within your assigned market.

Collaborate directly with leadership as Arriv's products and sales organization continue to evolve.

Our approach is discovery first.

We don't want Sales Growth Advisors pushing the largest package possible.

We want you to understand the customer's problem and recommend the Arriv solution that makes sense for their business.

Who We're Looking For

This opportunity may be a great fit for someone who:

✔ Enjoys talking with people

✔ Loves building professional relationships

✔ Is curious about technology

✔ Is comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers

✔ Is self-motivated

✔ Has an entrepreneurial mindset

✔ Enjoys solving problems

✔ Can manage their own pipeline and follow-up

✔ Is comfortable creating new opportunities

✔ Wants to grow alongside an early-stage technology company

✔ Is coachable, motivated, and willing to learn

Previous experience in B2B sales, SaaS, technology, business development, recruiting, payroll, HR technology, or other customer-facing roles is helpful, but not required.

You don't need to arrive knowing every Arriv product.

We'll teach you the technology, the sales process, and how the different parts of the ecosystem work together.

Compensation

This is a commission-based sales opportunity with uncapped earning potential.

Compensation may include:

Implementation/setup commissions on qualifying new customer accounts

Recurring commissions from eligible customer accounts

Performance accelerators

Additional sales incentives

There is no cap on commissions.

Because eligible accounts can generate recurring revenue, successful Sales Growth Advisors have the opportunity to build a growing portfolio of customer relationships rather than relying exclusively on one-time commissions.

Complete commission structures, eligibility requirements, and available accelerators are reviewed during the interview and onboarding process.

Estimated annual earnings: $20,000–$100,000+

Actual earnings depend on individual sales performance and are not guaranteed.

Why Sell Arriv?

Businesses increasingly rely on multiple platforms to manage communication, sales, recruiting, hiring, training, payroll, customer relationships, and internal operations.

Arriv is building technology designed to bring more of those functions into a connected ecosystem.

That gives our Sales Growth Advisors an opportunity to do more than simply sell software.

You'll learn how a business operates, identify where problems exist, and help determine where Arriv technology can provide value.

And because Arriv is still growing, you'll have the opportunity to introduce new products and capabilities to the relationships you build as the ecosystem expands.

Training & Support

Every Sales Growth Advisor receives:

Comprehensive onboarding

Sales training

Product and platform education

Software demonstration training

Prospecting and discovery training

Ongoing coaching

Sales resources

Marketing resources

Technology training

Founder support

new_jobs.title: Customer Service Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
**About Your Future with SPI**

Are you looking for a career with an industry leader that drives the future of energy-efficient insulation and building material products? Is being part of a company that is recognized as a *“Great Place to Work”* of value to you? Look no further! At SPI, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive team that reflects our values of integrity and innovation by delivering solutions that make a difference in the communities we serve. Here, you are part of a company that rewards your contributions and encourages you to take ownership of your career.

**Job Description**

**Your Responsibilities**

Our Inside Sales Representatives work cooperatively with outside sales and other members of the sales organization to grow existing customers, create new customers, and meet and/or exceed monthly sales quotas. This role plays a huge part in the success of our company, and it gives individuals an opportunity to grow as a sales professional while providing our customers an exemplary level of service.

* Generate new and repeat sales by providing product and technical information in a timely manner.
* Determine customer requirements and expectations in order to recommend specific products and solutions.
* Proactively recommend alternate products based on cost, availability, or specifications to increase customer satisfaction and improve transaction profitability.
* Present price, credit, and terms in accordance with standard procedures and customers’ profitability profiles.
* Accurately process customer transactions such as orders, quotes, or returns over the phone.
* Provide accurate information regarding availability of in-stock items.
* Obtain accurate information from vendors relating to shipment dates and expected date of delivery.
* Increase sales and average order size by means of cross-selling, up-selling, add-on sales, and offering promotional sale items.
* Educate customers on features and benefits of products in order to improve product related sales and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor scheduled shipment dates to ensure timely delivery and expedite when necessary.
* Contact customers following sales to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction.
* Fill customer requests for catalogs, information, or samples.
* Remain current on consumer preferences, changes in local codes, and product developments by attending sales meetings, vendor trainings, and trade shows.
* Setup and maintain customer files within company CRM.
* Identify trends in customer satisfaction or dissatisfaction to ensure higher levels of service in future transaction.
* Communicate to the purchasing department unexpected increases or decreases in demand for products.
* Assist in scheduled physical inventory counts.

new_jobs.description:
Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator

**PROVENANCE by Diana Michelle**  
900 North Michigan Shops | Chicago, IL  
**Part-Time | Approximately 15–25 hours per week**  
**Compensation: $24–$28 per hour, based on experience**

About PROVENANCE

PROVENANCE by Diana Michelle is an independent luxury boutique located at 900 North Michigan Shops in Chicago. We specialize in niche luxury fragrance, custom clothing, cashmere, jewelry and accessories, with an emphasis on exceptional product curation, personalized service, and long-term client relationships.

We are seeking a highly organized, trustworthy, and detail-oriented **Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator** to oversee the movement and documentation of merchandise from receipt through delivery to our boutique.

This is an operational role requiring a high degree of accuracy, discretion, personal accountability, and comfort working with valuable merchandise.

The Role

The Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator will help manage the merchandise flow between our vendors, receiving location, inventory system, and retail boutique.

You will be responsible for ensuring that incoming merchandise is properly received, counted, inspected, documented, entered into our inventory system when authorized, organized, and transferred to the store with a clear chain of custody.

Because this position involves access to valuable merchandise and confidential business information, **integrity, discretion, and adherence to security procedures are essential.**

Key ResponsibilitiesInventory Receiving & Verification

* Receive domestic and international merchandise shipments.
* Carefully open, inspect, and count incoming merchandise.
* Match merchandise against packing slips, invoices, purchase orders, and other receiving documentation.
* Verify quantities, SKUs, product descriptions, and other identifying information.
* Identify shortages, overages, incorrect merchandise, damaged goods, or other discrepancies.
* Photograph and document shipments or discrepancies when appropriate.
* Promptly report receiving issues to management rather than making unauthorized corrections or assumptions.

Lightspeed & Inventory Records

* Receive approved merchandise into the Lightspeed POS/inventory system.
* Accurately enter and verify quantities and product information.
* Maintain clean and accurate inventory records.
* Assist with inventory counts and reconciliation.
* Help identify discrepancies between physical merchandise and system inventory.
* Maintain accurate documentation of merchandise transfers and adjustments.
* Follow established authorization procedures for inventory changes.

System access will be limited to the functions necessary for the position. This role does not require unrestricted access to customer information, financial reporting, or other sensitive areas of the business.

Inventory Organization & Logistics

* Maintain an organized and secure receiving area.
* Sort and prepare merchandise for transfer to the PROVENANCE boutique.
* Label and organize merchandise according to established procedures.
* Coordinate the movement of inventory between the receiving location and store.
* Maintain clear documentation and chain of custody for merchandise movements.
* Confirm that merchandise leaving one location is accurately accounted for upon arrival at the other.
* Assist with vendor returns, damaged merchandise, shipment exceptions, and other inventory-related logistics.
* Keep receiving and storage areas orderly, professional, and secure.

Inventory Accuracy & Loss Prevention

* Follow established procedures for handling high-value merchandise.
* Maintain accurate counts throughout the receiving and transfer process.
* Document inventory movement rather than relying on memory or informal communication.
* Immediately escalate missing merchandise, unexplained discrepancies, damaged shipments, or unusual circumstances.
* Follow PROVENANCE security, access-control, and loss-prevention procedures at all times.

Confidentiality & Professional Standards

This position may provide access to confidential business information, including inventory levels, vendor information, purchasing records, product costs, receiving documentation, and internal operating procedures.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working within strict confidentiality and access-control guidelines.

Company information may not be copied, exported, photographed, stored on personal devices, forwarded to personal accounts, or shared with unauthorized individuals.

We believe access should be based on what is necessary to perform the job. The Inventory & Logistics Coordinator will therefore receive the system and physical access required for the position without unnecessary access to unrelated confidential business information.

Who We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who is:

* Exceptionally detail-oriented and accurate.
* Reliable and consistent.
* Highly organized.
* Trustworthy and discreet.
* Comfortable being accountable for valuable merchandise.
* Able to work independently without sacrificing accuracy.
* Methodical about documentation and process.
* Comfortable following security and access-control procedures.
* Able to identify discrepancies and escalate them appropriately.
* Professional in handling confidential business information.
* Comfortable learning inventory and POS technology.
* Someone who takes pride in leaving systems, merchandise, and workspaces organized.

You should naturally be the kind of person who notices when **12 units arrived but the paperwork says 13**—and who stops to investigate rather than simply entering the number into the system.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is helpful:

* Luxury retail
* Inventory management
* Merchandise receiving
* Stockroom or back-of-house operations
* Retail operations
* Showroom operations
* Logistics or fulfillment
* POS or inventory-management systems
* High-va

**Event Coordinator**  
**Gatherline Events · Chicago, IL · Hybrid with on-site event work**  
**$27–$30 per hour · Full-time, W-2**

Gatherline Events organizes conferences, team meetings, and client events for businesses and nonprofit organizations.

We’re looking for an Event Coordinator to help turn approved plans into well-organized events. You’ll work with an Event Producer, supporting registration, supplier coordination, schedules, and on-site delivery. You won’t be expected to lead complex events independently from day one.

**What you’ll do**

* Maintain event schedules, task lists, guest records, and planning documents.
* Request supplier quotes and confirm arrangements for catering, audiovisual equipment, signage, and transportation.
* Prepare attendee communications, joining instructions, name badges, and registration materials.
* Track confirmations, deadlines, and approved costs, raising missing information or changes promptly.
* Support events on-site by coordinating check-in, briefing suppliers, and helping guests find the right information.
* Collect feedback and organize receipts, invoices, and outstanding items after each event.

The Event Producer owns the overall budget, client commitments, and major supplier decisions. You’ll receive clear approval limits and a named escalation contact.

**What you’ll bring**

* Around one to two years of experience in events, hospitality, administration, or another role involving bookings and customer coordination.
* Strong organization and accuracy when handling names, dates, quantities, and instructions.
* Clear communication with guests, colleagues, and suppliers.
* Confidence using spreadsheets, shared calendars, and presentation tools.
* The ability to stay composed when plans change and ask for support when needed.

Relevant internships, volunteer event work, and community projects count toward experience. A college degree and event-management certification are not required. Familiarity with registration platforms is helpful; training is provided.

**Schedule, location, and travel**

During planning weeks, expect approximately **40 working hours**, usually Monday–Friday during Central Time business hours. The normal arrangement is three days in our Chicago office and two days remote.

Event assignments replace the usual office schedule and can include early starts, evenings, or weekends. Expect approximately **one or two evening or weekend assignments per month**, with busier periods communicated through the event calendar.

Event weeks may reach **45–50 hours**. All working hours are recorded, and hours worked above 40 in a workweek are paid at 1.5 times your regular rate. Meal breaks are separate from working hours.

Most events are in Greater Chicago. Expect up to four domestic trips annually, usually lasting two to three nights. Approved transportation, accommodation, and meals are covered, and required business travel time is paid under our company policy.

On-site work includes extended periods of standing and walking and handling light event materials. Reasonable accommodations are available.

**Pay and benefits**

* **$27–$30 per hour**, based on relevant coordination and event experience.
* Approximately **$56,160–$62,400 annually** at 2,080 paid hours, excluding overtime. No commission.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer contributions.
* 401(k) with an employer match.
* 15 paid vacation days, paid company holidays, and separate sick leave.
* Company laptop, required software, and paid onboarding.
* Support for approved event-industry training and professional development.

You’ll initially support smaller meetings and accompany an experienced colleague on-site before taking ownership of more complex assignments.

**How to apply**

Submit your résumé and a brief example of an event, booking, or project you helped organize. Explain your contribution; a formal portfolio is not required.

Our process includes an introductory call and a conversation with the hiring manager about a sample event scenario. There is no take-home assignment.

Candidates must be able to commute to Chicago, meet the event and travel requirements, and be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available. Interview accommodations are available upon request.

Pay: $27.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60618

**Built on service. Powered by people.**
========================================

Impact exists because a small group of industry leaders believed companies in our space were doing it wrong. Many prioritized margins while the people doing the work and the clients relying on it became an afterthought. Impact was built differently: invest in great people, trust them to do great work, and deliver the kind of service clients remember. That approach helped us grow from a small office technology company into a national managed services provider, while remaining privately owned and people-first.

What makes Impact special is that growth has never come at the expense of the values that got us here. We continue to reinvest in our people, our capabilities, and the opportunities ahead so employees can grow alongside the business. We’ve built something special, but we’re far from finished. The people who join Impact now will help define what comes next.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are looking for a Marketing Manager who owns client relationships — not just manages them. Accountable for the full client experience from Executive Marketing Consultant handoff through renewal, the Marketing Manager serves as a fractional marketing director for a portfolio of 8-10 B2B clients. You translate each client’s business case into 90-day execution plans, lead Quarterly Business Reviews and Campaign Planning Reviews, direct cross-functional delivery across Strategy, Creative, Paid Media, and Web, and own the renewal conversation. Success in this role is defined by one thing: your clients’ businesses grow, and they renew because of it. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the primary client relationship from Executive Marketing Consultant handoff through renewal and expansion as the client’s single point of strategic accountability at IMM.
* Own the client business case as the single source of truth and continuously pressure-test it against evolving client objectives and market conditions.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and Campaign Planning Reviews by building the narrative, running the meeting, and following through on every commitment.
* Translate annual strategy into 90-day, hypothesis-driven execution plans tied to client business outcomes.
* Direct cross-functional delivery across Strategy, Creative, Paid Media, and Web for assigned accounts, aligning the team around the business case rather than only the task list.
* Manage the account handoff process by reviewing the full brief, flagging gaps, signing off in writing, and booking the first client check-in within 5 business days.
* Proactively monitor retention risk, account health, and expansion potential, surfacing threats and opportunities before they require escalation.
* Identify and present upsell and cross-sell opportunities to clients, with expansion MRR tracked and reviewed quarterly.
* Own the renewal conversation with support from the Head of Delivery on at-risk accounts.
* Maintain IMM Elevate records, including brief submissions, account intelligence, performance data, and renewal documentation.
* Write and execute an annual Business Plan covering role north star, value creation targets, strategic exclusions, and personal operating system.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* 3-5 years of account management, client services, or marketing management experience at an agency or B2B marketing services firm.
* Proven ownership of client business reviews, including building the narrative, running the meeting, and handling hard conversations when results are off.
* B2B marketing fluency with an understanding of how marketing connects to pipeline, revenue, and business outcomes.

* Active AI workflow adoption, with current hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day work.

* Demonstrated ability to identify retention risk early and address it before it becomes a client-facing problem.

* Executive communication skills with the confidence to challenge clients with perceptiveness and business acumen.
* Disciplined operating rhythm, including timely QBRs, current Elevate records, and an active business plan.

**What Drives Impact**
----------------------

Behaviors define what our core values look like in action. Leaders are expected to model them; teams are expected to live them:

* Innovation: We embrace change because innovation lives outside the comfort zone.
* Passion: We are driven by purpose, fueled by passion, and obsessed with making an impact.
* Honesty: We are fiercely transparent and consistently honest.
* Fun: We fuel work with fun, knowing life's too short for boring.
* Low Ego: We champion ideas over titles, because brilliance knows no rank.
* One Team: We win as a team, we lose as a team, we are one team.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skillset, experience and training, licensures and/or certifications, and other organizational needs.

Impact may offer applicable incentive compensation plans depending on role and/or department.

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager (Part-Time)
new_jobs.description:
Part-Time Social Media Manager

**Crepe Nation Express | Old Town, Chicago**

About Crepe Nation Express

Crepe Nation Express is a Fast-Casual Sweet & Savory Brunch Concept focused on crepes, waffles, and pancakes.

Our journey started with a restaurant over five years ago. After two years of operating our original restaurant, we stepped away from the restaurant side to focus on developing and growing our signature mixes. Today, those same mixes are used both by customers at home and in our restaurant.

Crepe Nation Express is our return to the restaurant space with a new, lightweight express model. Our first location is now open in Old Town, Chicago, and we're building the brand both inside the restaurant and throughout the local community.

Our customers are our **Citizens**, and we're looking for someone who can help bring the Crepe Nation Express experience to life online.

The Role

We're looking for a **Part-Time Social Media Manager** to take ownership of our social media presence.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be on-site creating high-quality photos and videos, planning and publishing content, keeping our channels active, engaging with our community, and finding ways to get Crepe Nation Express in front of more people in Chicago.

We're not looking for someone who simply posts when they are told to. We want someone who understands social media, pays attention to what's happening in the community, spots opportunities, creates content around them, and knows how to turn everyday moments at the restaurant into content people want to see.

You will not be required to be the face of the brand. Your job is to capture the brand, the food, the experience, and the community around it.

What You'll Do

Content Creation

* Create high-quality photos and videos of our food, restaurant, team, customers, events, and day-to-day experiences
* Develop original content ideas that fit the Crepe Nation Express brand
* Capture content on-site consistently
* Turn everyday moments at the restaurant into engaging social content
* Create content around new menu items, promotions, events, and seasonal opportunities

Social Media Management

* Maintain a consistent posting schedule across our social platforms
* Plan content ahead while remaining flexible enough to respond to trends and opportunities
* Write captions and social copy that fit our brand voice
* Keep our social channels active, current, and engaging
* Monitor comments, direct messages, tags, and mentions
* Respond to our online community and encourage meaningful interaction

Community & Local Growth

* Build relationships with local creators, influencers, foodies, businesses, and community members
* Identify local influencers and creators who align with the Crepe Nation Express brand
* Reach out to and develop collaborations with relevant local creators
* Engage with local conversations, events, trends, and communities
* Find opportunities to get Crepe Nation Express involved in the Old Town and wider Chicago community
* Help turn online engagement into visits to the restaurant

Trends & Growth

* Stay ahead of social media trends and identify opportunities relevant to the brand
* Participate in trends when they make sense for Crepe Nation Express
* Develop original trends, content concepts, and recurring series that people can associate with the brand
* Test different types of content and learn from what performs
* Monitor social media performance and use insights to improve future content

What We're Looking For

* Proven experience managing social media for a brand, business, creator, restaurant, or similar organization
* Strong photography and video skills
* A strong eye for what makes content visually appealing and engaging
* Understanding of what performs on platforms such as Instagram and TikTok
* Creative thinker who can consistently come up with new content ideas
* Strong writing and communication skills
* Comfortable working independently and taking initiative
* Strong understanding of social media trends and online communities
* Ability to work on-site at our Old Town location to create content
* Strong interest in food, hospitality, culture, and local communities

**A portfolio or examples of previous social media work are required.**

What Success Looks Like

You'll know you're doing a great job when:

* Crepe Nation Express is consistently showing up in people's feeds
* Our content looks professional, current, and unmistakably ours
* Our audience is growing and actively engaging with our content
* Local creators and influencers know who we are
* People are talking about us online without us having to ask
* Our social channels feel like an extension of the restaurant itself
* Social media is contributing to awareness, community, and visits to the restaurant

Why Join Crepe Nation Express?

* Part-time position with a growing food brand
* Creative ownership of our social media presence
* Opportunity to help shape the voice and identity of the brand
* Work directly with a growing restaurant in Old Town, Chicago
* Employee meal discounts
* Opportunity to grow with the brand

**Location:** Old Town, Chicago  
**Position:** Part-Time Social Media Manager

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a portfolio or examples of previous social media work? If yes, include it in your application.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60610

**Sales Development Representative (Inside Sales)**

**Must live in one of these areas:**

* **Memphis or Nashville, TN**

* **Charlotte, NC**

* **Orlando, FL**
* **Raleigh, NC**
* **St. Louis, MO**
* **Jacksonville, FL**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a driven, curious, and resilient Sales Development Representative to join our Inside Sales Team. This is not a holding pattern role; it is the first chapter of a clearly defined career in sales.

As an SDR, you will be responsible for generating qualified meetings through a mix of outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification. You will work closely with your field sales counterparts to hand off those meetings, ensuring every introduction is well-briefed, timely, and set up to convert.

This role is also the foundation of your sales career. The skills, commercial instincts, and client relationships you build here are what will prepare you for promotion to Business Development Manager within 6 to 12 months, where you will own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close.

This role is built on two foundations. First, execution: showing up, doing the work, and consistently delivering output. Second, growth: developing the judgment, curiosity, and persuasion skills that turn a good SDR into a great closer.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Pipeline generation**

* Execute high-volume outbound prospecting via phone, email, and other tools to identify and engage potential clients

* Qualify inbound leads using a structured framework, assessing fit, urgency, and decision-making authority

* Book qualified meetings and hand them off to a BDM with a thorough, well-prepared brief

* Consistently meet or exceed weekly and monthly activity and meeting targets

**Client engagement**

* Research target accounts before outreach, understand their business, hiring challenges, and the commercial impact of those challenges

* Ask enough of the right questions during outreach to qualify the opportunity and set your BDM up for a strong first conversation

* Handle common objections confidently and credibly, influencing rather than scripting your way through conversations

* Follow up on the outcomes of your handoffs, stay curious about what happens after the meeting is booked and use it to sharpen your approach

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with your BDM counterparts, providing thorough meeting briefs and acting as a reliable first point of contact for new prospects

* Keep Salesforce records accurate and up to date, logging all activity and tracking pipeline stages

* Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles, rapidly applying feedback to improve your approach

* Contribute to a culture of high activity, honest feedback, and shared accountability

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

We hire for two things: the ability to execute today, and the potential to grow into a future closer. You do not need to have worked in staffing before. You do need to be the kind of person who finds a way to get things done.

**Execution — you deliver consistent output and pipeline**

Grit / Resilience

You sustain performance through rejection. A tough week doesn’t derail you — it sharpens your focus.

Activity Capacity

You are comfortable with high-volume outreach and bring structure and energy to every day.

Work Ethic / Discipline

You manage your own time, set your own targets, and don’t need close supervision to stay on track.

Coachability

You take feedback fast and apply it faster. You see coaching as a competitive advantage, not a criticism.

**Growth — you have the potential to become a future BDM**

Business Acumen

You connect hiring challenges to business impact. You ask why, not just what.

Discovery Depth

You ask the question behind the question. You don’t surface needs — you uncover them.

Ownership Mindset

You think beyond the meeting. You care about outcomes, not just activity.

Deal Curiosity

You want to know what happens after the handoff. You use those lessons to get better.

Persuasion Skills

You influence rather than script. You adapt to the person in front of you.

Internal Selling

You collaborate well. You know that winning externally starts with alignment internally.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* A genuine interest in sales and a clear desire to build a career as a closer

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, you can hold a conversation and write a compelling email

* A track record of hitting targets or goals in any context: work, academics, sport, or otherwise

* The ability to handle rejection and keep going without losing energy or professionalism

* Comfort with technology, CRM tools, LinkedIn and email sequencing platforms

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in a sales, customer-facing, or high-volume outreach role

* Exposure to the staffing, recruiting, or workforce solutions industry

* Experience using Salesforce and sales enablement platforms

* A degree in business, communications, or a related field, though we care more about drive than credentials

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

In your first 30 days, you will have completed onboarding, learned our solutions and client base, started your first outreach cadences, and booked your first qualified meetings.

By 90 days, you will be consistently hitting your meeting targets, running discovery calls with support, and actively contributing to pipeline. Your CRM will be clean, your activity levels high, and your feedback loops fast.

By 6 to 12 months, you will have demonstrated readiness to progress to Business Development Manager, running
